title: GTA 6 Gameplay Recorder
description:
We are looking for reliable and experienced GTA 5 players to record high-quality gameplay footage from GTA 6.



Your job is simple: **we provide the scenes and instructions, you record the gameplay and send us the raw footage.**



You will NOT need to edit videos, create thumbnails, write scripts, or record voiceovers.



We are looking for people interested in a long-term collaboration.



## Responsibilities



- Record GTA 6 gameplay following our detailed scene lists.

- Capture specific missions, vehicles, locations, characters, interactions, and gameplay moments.

- Record 2–3 different takes of each requested scene whenever necessary.

- Follow instructions carefully to capture the exact shots we need.

- Organize and name all files according to our instructions.

- Upload original, unedited footage to Google Drive.

- Occasionally test specific gameplay mechanics or scenarios.

- Complete most assignments within 24–48 hours.



## Requirements



- Own a PS5, PS5 Pro, or Xbox Series X/S capable of running GTA 6.

- Have access to GTA 6 when assignments begin.

- Experience playing GTA games, preferably GTA V or GTA Online.

- Ability to record gameplay at a minimum of 1080p / 60 FPS.

- 1440p or 4K recording is a plus.

- Clean gameplay recordings without microphone audio, facecam, notifications, or external overlays.

- In-game radio and copyrighted music must be disabled.

- No mods or cheats unless specifically requested.

- Reliable internet connection for uploading large video files.

- Good communication and ability to follow detailed instructions.



A capture card is a plus, but not mandatory if your console recording setup produces high-quality footage.



## Payment



**We pay $1 USD per minute of the final edited YouTube video, NOT per minute of raw recorded footage.**



Examples:



- 10-minute final video = $10 USD

- 15-minute final video = $15 USD

- 20-minute final video = $20 USD

title: Sales Virtual Assistant — Cold Calling & Lead Conversion for Residential and Commercial Cleaning
description:
Cado Premier Cleaning Group provides residential and commercial cleaning in the Indianapolis area. We're growing, and we need a closer. Someone who picks up the phone, calls people back fast, and turns inquiries into booked cleanings. This is a sales job first. You'll call new leads, follow up until they d
, and get property managers to say yes to a walkthrough and a quote.



Schedule and pay

20 paid hours per week. Proposed coverage: Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m. Indianapolis time (America/Indiana/Indianapolis, Eastern Time). Final hours will be agreed before starting. A mutually agreed split shift is possible. No monitoring is expected outside paid coverage. Required training, meetings and administration are paid. Initial paid trial: 30 calendar days.

Base pay is $5 USD/hour. Bonuses: $5 for a new one-time residential client's first completed and paid job; $10 for a new recurring client's first completed and paid visit; $10 for an attended qualified commercial walkthrough; and another $25 after a new commercial account's first invoice is paid. Written eligibility rules apply; bonuses are not guaranteed.



What you will do

• Call new leads fast, during coverage hours — Yelp, Thumbtack, Google-origin leads, Nextdoor,
, website forms and the business phone. Speed matters. Most jobs go to whoever calls back first.

• Follow up until they book or say no. Most people don't book on the first call. You'll call, text and
, keep every lead warm, and never let one go quiet.

• Cold call property managers, apartment complexes, offices and short-term rental managers. Pitch our turnover and commercial cleaning, get them to accept a quote, and book a walkthrough.

• Present quotes with confidence and close the booking — standard, deep, move-out or recurring. Handle "I need to think about it" and price objections without being pushy.

• Ask about size, rooms, condition, priorities and extras; prepare approved routine quotes or refer exceptions to the owner.

• Maintain clear CRM notes, coordinate with existing automations and give the owner a short daily handoff: what's booked, what's pending, and what's next.

What we are looking for

A closer, not just a communicator. You've sold on the phone before — home services, cleaning or something similar — and you're comfortable hearing no and calling back anyway. Clear spoken and written English, good listening, reliable follow-through, and comfort with business phone and CRM tools. You need a suitable computer, headset, quiet calling space and dependable internet. We assess understandable communication and judgment, not accent imitation.



How to apply

Apply through this listing with your resume, country/time zone, Indianapolis-time availability and answers to the screening questions. Include a 45–60 second voice introduction and a short explanation of why a deep clean differs from standard cleaning. Also tell us about one time you turned a "let me think about it" into a yes. Tell us if you need an alternative submission format. Finalists will be offered a paid practical exercise.

title: Part-Time Video Editor for YouTube & Shorts (Real Estate / Mortgage Educational Channel)
description:
I’m a loan officer in the San Francisco Bay Area, and I run a YouTube channel that teaches homebuyers and real estate agents in plain English. I film the raw footage myself, mostly talking-head videos shot on my phone or camera. I need an editor who can turn that footage into clean, engaging videos that feel calm, professional, and easy to follow. This is ongoing work, and the right person can stay with me long-term.



What you’ll edit each week



*1 long-form YouTube video, 8–15 minutes long: cut out mistakes and long pauses, tighten the pacing, add captions, B-roll, simple text callouts, and my branded intro and end card

*3–4 YouTube Shorts / Instagram Reels, 30–60 seconds long: cut from the long video, vertical 9:16 format, bold captions, and a strong hook in the first 2 seconds

*1 thumbnail per long video, made in Canva or Photoshop using my brand colors



Style



*Calm and educational, not hype. Avoid flashy transitions, loud sound effects, and clickbait.

*Brand colors are navy (#1B3A6B) and gold (#C8992A). 

*Fonts are Playfair Display and Inter.

*Use only royalty-free music, such as YouTube Audio Library, Epidemic Sound, or Artlist.



Turnaround and tools



*Edits delivered within 48–72 hours of receiving the footage

*Files shared through Google Drive

*Software: DaVinci Resolve (preferred) or Premiere Pro, plus Canva or Photoshop for thumbnails



Pay



*Paid per video. Starting rates: $25–40 per long-form video and $5–8 per Short, depending on experience

*One paid test edit before ongoing work begins



Requirements



*At least 1 year editing YouTube videos, especially talking-head or educational content

*Experience creating Shorts or Reels with burned-in captions

*Strong English, so captions and on-screen text have no typos

*Reliable with deadlines, and communicates early if something will be late

*A portfolio of real published work (YouTube links preferred)



Nice to have



*Experience editing for real estate, finance, or coaching channels

*Experience with thumbnail design and YouTube SEO (titles, chapters, tags)



How to apply



*Start your application with the words “East Bay YouTube.”

*Share 2–3 links to long-form talking-head videos you edited.

*Share 2–3 links to Shorts or Reels you edited.

*Tell me your usual turnaround time for a 10-minute video.

*Confirm your rate per long-form video and per Short.

title: Video Editor
description:
One-Time Gig: Video Creator for a Cinematic Drama-Style Ad



This is a one-time gig for a single video, and it is not an ongoing role or a full-time position. We are a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand looking for a video creator or small team who can produce one story-driven drama ad that matches the quality of the reference video below. If your work looks like a short film rather than a typical ad, we would like to hear from you.



Reference video: 



What the video looks like



The reference is a 7 to 8 minute vertical (9:16) short film that tells an emotional story about a woman who feels overlooked as she ages, with the product introduced naturally partway through. It has multiple characters with scripted dialogue and moves across several locations, including a restaurant, a retail counter, a family home, and a hotel in Paris. The lighting is warm and cinematic, the acting is believable, and the subtitles are clean and burned in. The pacing keeps viewers watching for the full length, which is the main reason this format works.



Gig scope



Production of one complete drama ad of similar length, quality, and emotional tone, built around a script we will provide or develop together with you.

Photorealistic visuals with consistent characters across every scene, whether you film live or use AI video tools such as Veo, Kling, or Higgsfield.

Natural-sounding dialogue with consistent voices for each character, and accents matched to the target market.

Professional editing, color grading, sound design, and music that support the story.

Burned-in subtitles in a clean style similar to the reference.

Final delivery in 9:16 at 1080x1920, with a 4:5 version if possible.



Ideal candidate



You have a portfolio of narrative or cinematic video work, and ideally you have made drama-style or story-led ads for e-commerce or direct-response brands. You can keep characters and settings consistent across a long video, and you understand pacing well enough to hold attention for several minutes. Experience with AI filmmaking tools is a strong plus, but strong traditional production experience is equally welcome.



To apply, please send



Two or three samples of your best narrative or cinematic video work, especially anything long-form or ad-related.

A short explanation of how you would produce this video, including whether you would film it, generate it with AI, or combine both.

A fixed price and turnaround time for this one video.

Whether you can also help develop the script, or whether you prefer to work from a finished one.



Payment is a flat fee for this single project, and the gig ends once the final video is delivered and approved. Applications without relevant samples will not be considered.

title: AI Video Creator & Animator for Cinematic Football Brainrot Content (Long-Term)
description:
About the Project



We are a content production team specializing in AI-generated football entertainment videos for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.



We are looking for a highly skilled AI Video Creator who can join our production workflow and help us create high-quality, realistic, cinematic AI videos.



This is not a typical video editing job. We need someone who understands AI image generation, image-to-video animation, character consistency, storytelling, character interactions, sound design, and short-form content production.



Our goal is to produce entertaining, highly engaging football-themed Brainrot videos with professional visuals, creative storytelling, and strong viral potential.



1. Our Content Style



Our videos feature famous football players such as:



- Cristiano Ronaldo

- Neymar Jr.

- Kylian Mbappé

- Lionel Messi

- Lamine Yamal



We also use fictional and original characters, especially our signature wooden mascot character, Sahur (Tung Tung).



Our content combines football culture with absurd comedy, internet Brainrot humor, cinematic storytelling, and unexpected situations.



Here are examples of the stories and concepts we produce:



- Crazy pranks between football players and fictional characters.

- Funny interactions and arguments between famous football players.

- Unexpected challenges, competitions, and transformations.

- Unusual friendships, rivalries, and emotional stories.

- Characters getting into ridiculous or surprising situations.

- Creative storylines with unexpected twists and entertaining endings.



For example, Sahur and Neymar might secretly plan a prank on Cristiano Ronaldo, leading to a series of funny reactions and unexpected events.



The storytelling should feel entertaining, unpredictable, and visually exciting.



2. Visual Style & Quality



Visual quality is extremely important to us.



We are looking for:



- Realistic, high-quality AI-generated characters.

- Cinematic 3D visuals with realistic textures and lighting.

- Detailed environments and backgrounds.

- Professional camera angles and cinematic compositions.

- Natural facial expressions and body movements.

- Realistic character interactions.

- Consistent character appearance across different scenes.



IMPORTANT: We are NOT looking for basic cartoon animations, low-quality AI videos, slideshow-style videos, or generic AI-generated clips.



We want realistic, cinematic visuals that look professionally produced.



3. Character Consistency



One of the most important requirements is character consistency.



The same character must maintain the same facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and overall appearance throughout the entire video.



For example, if Cristiano Ronaldo appears in the first scene, he must look like the same character in every following scene.



Our original Sahur character must also maintain its established design and appearance across all scenes.



Characters should interact naturally with each other rather than appearing as disconnected AI-generated clips.



4. AI Video Production Responsibilities



You will be responsible for helping us produce videos from the initial creative concept to the final edited version.



Your responsibilities include:



A. AI Image Generation



- Generate high-quality cinematic images for individual scenes.

- Create realistic characters and environments.

- Follow visual references and creative instructions.

- Maintain consistent characters across scenes.

- Use appropriate camera angles, lighting, and compositions.



B. Image-to-Video Animation



- Transform generated images into high-quality video clips.

- Create realistic movements, gestures, and facial expressions.

- Animate characters walking, running, talking, reacting, laughing, fighting, and interacting.

- Ensure smooth and natural movements.

- Follow specific camera movement instructions.

- Avoid visual glitches, distorted faces, extra limbs, and unnatural animation.



C. Character Dialogue & Interaction



- Create scenes where characters communicate naturally.

- Synchronize character movements with dialogue where supported.

- Generate or integrate suitable character voices.

- Ensure characters react appropriately during conversations.

- Avoid frozen characters or static scenes when movement and interaction are required.



D. Sound Design



- Add appropriate sound effects for actions and reactions.

- Use background music that matches the emotional tone of each scene.

- Include comedy sounds, impact sounds, transitions, and environmental audio.

- Balance dialogue, music, and sound effects professionally.



E. Final Video Editing



- Assemble all generated scenes into one complete video.

- Maintain engaging pacing and smooth transitions.

- Add subtitles or captions when required.

- Synchronize dialogue, sound effects, and music.

- Deliver a polished final video ready for publication.



5. Video Specifications



Our typical video requirements are:



- Duration: approximately 60–90 seconds.

- Format: Vertical 9:16.

- Platforms: TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

- Language: English dialogue and voice-overs.

- Visual quality: Realistic, cinematic, high-quality AI visuals.

- Storytelling: Fast-paced, entertaining, and engaging.

- Strong opening hook within the first 1–2 seconds.

- Clear story progression with interesting character interactions.

- Unexpected or entertaining endings.



Most videos contain multiple short scenes. The number and duration of scenes depend on the storyline and editing requirements.



We prioritize retention, visual variety, and storytelling quality.



6. Tools & Technical Skills



We are open to different AI production tools, but you should have strong experience with modern AI image and video generation platforms.



Experience with tools such as the following is a plus:



- Grok

- Google Veo

- Kling AI

- Runway

- Midjourney

- Flux

- Nano Banana

- Other advanced AI image and video generation tools.



You do not need to use every tool listed above. What matters most is your ability to deliver the required visual quality and consistent results.



7. Working Process



Our team will provide:



- Creative concepts and story ideas.

- Story direction and scene requirements.

- Character references.

- Visual references and examples of our existing content.

- Detailed instructions for the required style and production quality.



You will be responsible for translating these instructions into high-quality AI-generated scenes and complete videos.



We already have an established creative direction and production workflow. We need someone who can understand our style, follow our references, and consistently reproduce the required quality while also bringing creative ideas when appropriate.



8. What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate should:



- Have a strong portfolio of AI-generated videos.

- Understand cinematic AI image and video production.

- Be experienced with realistic character animation.

- Know how to maintain character consistency.

- Understand storytelling and short-form video pacing.

- Have good sound design and editing skills.

- Be detail-oriented and able to follow creative instructions.

- Communicate clearly and deliver projects on time.

- Be interested in a long-term working relationship.



Previous experience creating AI football videos, Brainrot content, or viral TikTok videos is a significant advantage.



9. Test Project & Long-Term Collaboration



We are looking to build a long-term relationship with the right creator.



We will initially start with a paid test project to evaluate your production skills, creativity, visual quality, and ability to follow our established style.



If the test project meets our expectations, we would like to establish regular collaboration with ongoing video production.



10. How to Apply



When applying, please answer the following questions:



1. Have you previously created realistic AI-generated videos featuring famous football players or fictional characters?

2. Can you create consistent characters across multiple scenes?

3. Which AI image generation and video animation tools do you use?

4. Can you handle the complete production process, including image generation, animation, dialogue, sound effects, and final editing?

5. Have you created content specifically for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or Instagram Reels?

6. How long does it typically take you to produce a complete 60–90 second video?



Please include at least 2–3 examples of your best AI video work.



We are particularly interested in creators who can demonstrate realistic character animation, natural interactions, cinematic visuals, and engaging storytelling.



We are not simply looking for someone who knows how to use AI tools. We are looking for a creative production partner who can help us consistently produce high-quality AI football entertainment content.



If you believe you can reproduce this style and meet our quality standards, we would love to hear from you.

title: DTC Inventory and Order Reporting Specialist
description:
Remote | Full Time | CST



How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience in inventory management, accounting operations, supply chain reporting, order management, or data reconciliation. Answers to the questions below are also required.



About the Company

We are a growing e-commerce business operating across multiple online sales channels and retail marketplaces. Our operations involve inventory management, order fulfillment, warehouse coordination, and maintaining accurate business records. We value analytical thinking, accountability, and individuals who take ownership of maintaining reliable operational processes.



About the Role

We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Inventory and Order Reporting Specialist to maintain the accuracy and consistency of our inventory, order, and operational records.



You will be responsible for reviewing inventory and transaction data, reconciling records, preparing operational reports, and investigating discrepancies involving warehouse counts, shipments, invoices, and orders. The role also involves coordinating with external warehouse partners and supporting e-commerce inventory and listing operations. This opportunity is particularly suited for professionals with backgrounds in inventory accounting, supply chain analysis, e-commerce accounting, accounts payable, or operational reporting.



Key Responsibilities

- Prepare daily sales reports and recurring operational reports using information from different business systems and reporting sources.

- Maintain accurate inventory and order records across the company's various sales and distribution channels.

- Reconcile inventory balances against warehouse counts, receiving records, shipment documentation, and customer returns.

- Review stock movements, inventory adjustments, order transactions, and fulfillment records to identify inconsistencies and unexplained variances.

- Investigate discrepancies involving inventory quantities, order records, shipment information, invoices, and other operational transactions.

- Review warehouse invoices and supporting documentation, verify individual charges against available business records, and coordinate the resolution of disputed transactions.

- Assist with the preparation and verification of purchase orders, packing lists, shipping documents, and other operational paperwork.

- Coordinate with external warehouse and third-party logistics partners regarding inventory counts, receiving, shipments, returns, and fulfillment-related concerns.

- Maintain accurate product information, inventory files, and marketplace listings across platforms such as Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and other retailer portals.

- Review inventory files and marketplace uploads to ensure that product quantities, SKUs, and other details match approved source information.

- Support customer inquiries involving order status, shipments, refunds, returns, and warranty claims, including the proper documentation and reconciliation of related transactions.

- Monitor outstanding customer support tickets and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution.

- Maintain accurate spreadsheets, reconciliation trackers, operational reports, and supporting documentation.

- Document recurring reporting and reconciliation procedures through standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Identify opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, reporting processes, and operational workflows, and assist with approved systems improvements and automations.



Qualifications and Requirements

- At least 2 years of professional experience in inventory management, inventory accounting, supply chain reporting, order reconciliation, operational reporting, or a related analytical function.

- Demonstrated experience reconciling operational data such as inventory balances, order transactions, invoices, purchase orders, shipments, or sales records.

- Experience investigating discrepancies, identifying variances, and tracing figures back to their original sources.

- Strong understanding of inventory records, stock movements, receiving transactions, and warehouse documentation.

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookup functions, data validation, and reconciliation trackers.

- Experience working with ERP, inventory management, accounting, or order management systems.

- Hands-on experience with e-commerce product listings, inventory updates, Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, or retailer marketplace portals.

- Strong numerical aptitude, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.

- Previous experience working remotely and the ability to maintain productivity in a remote working environment.





How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience in inventory management, accounting operations, supply chain reporting, order management, or data reconciliation. Answers to the questions below are also required.

1. How many years of professional experience do you have in inventory management, supply chain, accounting, or operations reporting?

2. Do you have experience working with inventory records, order data, or operational reports? Please briefly describe your relevant experience.

3. What companies, industries, or systems have you previously worked with that are relevant to inventory, order management, or reporting?



Applications demonstrating strong analytical capabilities, relevant reconciliation experience, and familiarity with e-commerce operations will be prioritized.

Financial Reporting

• Prepare and review financial statements and supporting schedules

Requirements:

title: Full-Time Short-Form Clipper: Turn Real Estate Podcasts Into Viral Reels, Shorts & TikToks
description:
We're a content and marketing agency that turns long-form real estate investing content (podcasts, interviews, YouTube videos, webinars) into short-form clips that go viral and bring in leads. We're hiring one full-time clipper who will become a core part of the team.

This is not a basic editing job. We don't need someone who just cuts out the "ums." We need someone who can watch a 60-minute episode, find the 30 seconds that will stop someone mid-scroll, and rebuild that moment into a clip people watch to the end.

What you'll do every day

• Watch full long-form videos (30 to 120+ minutes) and find every moment worth clipping: bold claims, numbers, stories, hot takes, "aha" lines

• Deliver as many clips as the video truly supports. There is no quota: every clip must be well-rounded, add real value and stand on its own

• Cut every pause, stutter, filler word, false start and second of dead air. Clips must be fast-paced and tight from start to finish

• Reverse-engineer each clip: move the strongest line to the front as the hook, cut the slow parts, rearrange pieces so the story lands, end on a payoff or CTA

• Edit vertical (9:16) with captions, punch-in zooms, B-roll and sound design that keep the pace up without looking cheap

• Do all clipping by hand. We do not use Opus Clip or any AI auto-clipping tool

• Create visual on-screen hooks when asked. We want to see your creativity here

• Study viral clips in our niche, track what performs, and bring new ideas every week

You must have

• 1+ year clipping or repurposing long-form into short-form (podcast, interview or talking-head content)

• A portfolio with links to real posted clips and their view counts

• 100% manual editing skills: you find the moments and make the cuts yourself, no AI auto-clipping

• Fast, precise cleanup: you remove stutters, filler and dead air quickly without cuts feeling jumpy

• A strong grasp of short-form structure: hook in the first 1 to 3 seconds, value, pacing, retention, payoff, CTA

• Working knowledge of real estate investing (rentals, flips, BRRRR, wholesaling, cash flow, cap rate, creative finance), or the drive to learn it fast. You need to know which moment is valuable to an investor

• Premiere Pro, CapCut (desktop) or DaVinci Resolve

• Excellent written English and comprehension of fast spoken American English

• Reliable internet and a backup power plan

• Available 40 hrs/week with 3 to 4 hours overlapping US Eastern time

Big plus

• You've clipped for a podcast or creator with 100K+ followers

• You've had clips pass 1M views

• A strong eye for visual hooks: on-screen text, motion and framing that grab attention

• You can explain why a clip went viral, not just that it did

What we offer

• $5/hr, full-time, long-term

• Monthly performance bonus tied to views and retention, plus a bonus for any clip over 100K views

• Raises at 3 and 6 months based on results

• Path to Lead Editor as the agency grows

• Clear feedback and a team that cares about making great content

How to apply

Start your proposal with the word HOOKFIRST so we know you read this. Then answer the screening questions. Proposals without links to posted clips will not be reviewed. Every shortlisted applicant completes a paid sample edit before we hire. It's how we see if you're the right fit.

s, and phone numbers without hiding software buttons and menus. Initial target: 1 long-form tutorial + 2 shorts weekly.

Original walkthrough footage only. Use only verified facts I give you — never invent a price, feature, incentive, or payment. Initial target: 1 long-form tour + 2-3 shorts weekly, depending on available footage.



Weekly volumes are initial targets, not guaranteed assignments. Work is flexible, remote, and assignment-based. There are no guaranteed minimum hours — please confirm availability before accepting each assignment. Both tracks follow the same rules: editing only, follow the template exactly, protect privacy, and return the project file. What you will do: Track A — 8-12 min lessons, 16:9, hard cuts, chapter markers, agent shorts, presenter inset stays visible, captions big bold white on talking-head (current word gold), small in black bar below screen recordings (current word teal), no added text over any screen recording, blur last names/emails/phones everywhere, spell the name exactly: Falecia. Track B — 45-60 sec vertical tours + 8-12 min long-form tours + buyer shorts, smooth cuts, clean zooms, readable gold/white captions, watermark moves about every 15 seconds never covering face/caption/price/feature, CTA is Comment TOUR — booking link 
/book, no direct builder link, no invented pricing or incentives, deliver shorts without music baked in.



Both editors must have: CapCut (preferred) or Premiere Pro; proven experience in the formats relevant to your selected track only; accurate captions and spelling — check names word by word; clean privacy blurring that keeps controls visible; reliable internet for large files, clear written English, discipline to follow a template exactly — and ask before you guess.



You will NOT be asked to: film anything, write scripts, generate AI video or voice, publish or upload, contact clients, or promise results. If a detail is not in the brief, you ask — you do not invent it.



Project files — required on every delivery: Deliver the native editable CapCut or Premiere Pro project, all linked source media and assets, and the final exported MP4. Projects must open successfully on my system without missing files. CapCut is preferred whenever possible; Premiere Pro is accepted. Please disclose your exact software version and confirm project compatibility before accepting work.



Pay: Please provide your hourly rate and proposed fixed price per completed video for your selected track. Paid test compensation will be agreed upon before work begins. Payment schedule: Fixed price per approved video, paid through the agreed platform. Approval window is two business days after complete delivery; that window is for reviewing the completed delivery and either approving it or requesting corrections, not withholding payment indefinitely. Payment is made promptly under the platform's applicable terms.



Arrangement: Flexible, remote, assignment-based independent contractor work. No guaranteed minimum hours. Editors must confirm availability before accepting assignments. Turnaround: First cut due within 48-72 hours after receipt of all required footage, assets, and instructions. One consolidated revision round is included per video. Additional scope changes must be approved before work begins. Who edits: Independent editors preferred. If applying through a team or agency, identify the person performing the editing. No subcontracting or editor substitutions without written approval. Confidentiality: All supplied footage, client information, scripts, and project materials are confidential. Do not share, reuse, publish, or place them in a portfolio without written permission. Do not upload materials to third-party AI services without approval.



Please do not apply if: your portfolio is only weddings, cinematic reels, or AI-generated clips, or you cannot return the project file as described above. Generic copy-paste proposals will be deleted.



How to apply — read carefully: Start your application with the word NAVY so I know you read the whole post. Applications without it will not be interviewed. First line after NAVY: tell me your track — TRACK A (Work Smart Agent Academy), TRACK B (Win With Falecia), or BOTH. Then answer all six questions:

1. Link 2 videos you personally edited in your track's format — screen-share tutorials for Track A, vertical / long-form tours for Track B (both formats if you apply for BOTH). For each: what did you cut, and what software and project file did you deliver?

2. How would you blur names, phone numbers, and
s in a GoHighLevel screen recording without hiding the buttons and menus? Show an example if you have one. Track B applicants: How would you ensure property details and captions match the supplied footage and verified facts?

3. Please provide your hourly rate and proposed fixed price per completed video for your selected track. Paid test compensation will be agreed upon before work begins. Estimate only your selected track: Track A — a 10-minute raw screen-share lesson (hours and fixed price); Track B — a 60-second vertical tour (hours and fixed price). If you apply for BOTH, estimate both.

4. Who exactly will edit — you, by name, or someone else on a team?

5. Walk me through your caption quality check: how do you catch a misspelled name before delivery?

6. What is your first-cut turnaround, how many revision rounds do you include, and what are your working hours and time zone?

Paid test: Shortlisted applicants get a 60-90-second paid sample using supplied footage and a real editing template, with a fixed test fee agreed before work begins. No unpaid test work. Track A test covers privacy blurring and captions; Track B test covers pacing, captions, and watermark placement. Paid tests will be evaluated separately for each track. Successful candidates may be offered ongoing assignments based on quality, reliability, communication, and project-file delivery.

Strong hands-on Amazon US experience is essential. Experience with Walmart Marketplace and TikTok Shop is a strong advantage as we expand across platforms.



You’ll work directly with our founder and a team of specialists. Brand management is central to the role, with broader agency operations responsibilities available to someone who can also build the systems behind consistent delivery.



Brand strategy, listing excellence, and execution



Our listings should stand alongside the strongest in their categories—with distinctive brand voice, persuasive copy, thoughtful creative, and polished design. You should recognize exceptional work, explain what makes it effective, and guide the team toward that standard.



You’ll be responsible for:



Developing thoughtful brand strategies. Understand each brand’s audience, positioning, products, and competitive advantages. Use customer reviews, competitor research, search behavior, and account data to identify opportunities and establish clear priorities.



Owning listing quality. Develop, refine, and critically review copy so it is accurate, persuasive, and true to the brand. Every headline, bullet, and content section should serve a clear purpose.



Directing creative work. Guide our designers through clear briefs and specific feedback on listing images, infographics, A+ content, and other brand assets. Connect messaging, visual hierarchy, and product storytelling to customer needs.



Leading execution. Coordinate PPC, listing, creative, and troubleshooting specialists around shared priorities, clear responsibilities, and deadlines. Identify gaps and follow work through to completion.



Evaluating performance methodically. Assess traffic, conversion, sales, advertising efficiency, and inventory constraints. Form clear hypotheses, prioritize improvements, and measure results through structured testing where available.



Keeping clients and leadership informed. Communicate performance, recommendations, risks, and next steps clearly. Stay current on marketplace changes and turn relevant developments into practical action.



Building agency operations — expanded scope



Candidates with proven operations ability can also help build the infrastructure that keeps ShopHowell coordinated as it grows. This includes creating core systems and workflows from the ground up.



Responsibilities will include:



Design and connect CRM, project-management, reporting, and documentation systems, with reliable handoffs from sales through onboarding and ongoing account management.



Establish clear ownership, deadlines, quality standards, and accountability across brands and platforms, including coordination with Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop specialists.



Build practical workflows and automations, guide team adoption, and improve visibility into capacity, outstanding commitments, and delivery bottlenecks.



Qualifications and experience



Required



Hands-on experience working in Amazon US Seller Central, with meaningful responsibility for brand performance or listing optimization on live accounts.



A portfolio demonstrating excellent English-language listing copy, brand judgment, and creative direction, with a clear explanation of your personal contribution.



Strong understanding of keyword research, customer and competitor analysis, product positioning, and conversion-focused content.



Ability to interpret commercial performance data and work confidently with spreadsheets and relevant research and reporting tools.



Excellent written and spoken English for editing copy, communicating with clients, and giving constructive feedback.



Evidence of independent ownership: identifying opportunities, making sound recommendations, coordinating contributors, and following through on results.



Preferred



Experience managing multiple brands or client accounts in an ecommerce agency.



Hands-on experience with Walmart Marketplace or TikTok Shop.



For the expanded agency operations scope, candidates must also demonstrate experience building systems and workflows, introducing them to a team, and showing how they improved coordination or delivery.



Exceptional Amazon listing specialists with strong strategic judgment and the ability to grow into broader brand leadership are encouraged to apply. We place significant weight on work quality, ownership, and demonstrated results.



Compensation



Base pay is $15–$25 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated ability, independence, and agreed responsibilities. The highest end of the range is intended for someone who can own both brand management and broader agency operations.



You’ll also earn commission calculated as a percentage of sales revenue from the brands you manage. The percentage and calculation terms will be agreed before starting.



How to apply



Please include your résumé or professional profile, country and time zone, availability, desired hourly rate, and a brief summary of your platform experience.



Also share:



Two or three of your strongest English-language listing examples. Explain your contribution, the reasoning behind key decisions, and any measurable results. For performance claims, include the timeframe and other factors that may have influenced the outcome.



An example of initiative. Describe a problem or opportunity you identified and acted on without being asked.



An operations example, if applicable. Explain what existed beforehand, what you built, how the team adopted it, and what improved.



Work samples are an essential part of our evaluation. We’re looking for thoughtful decisions, strong execution, and clear evidence of your contribution. Anonymized examples are welcome.

title: DTC Operations Reporting Specialist
description:
Remote | Full Time | CST 



How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience in e-commerce operations, inventory management, reporting, and marketplace administration. Answers to the questions below are also required. 



We are a growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce business operating across multiple online sales channels and retail marketplaces. Our operations cover online sales, product management, inventory, order fulfillment, and customer support. We value accuracy, accountability, and individuals who take ownership of their work in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.



About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized and analytical DTC Operations Reporting Specialist to support our e-commerce reporting, inventory, fulfillment, and administrative operations.



You will work closely with the Operations team and external business partners to maintain accurate sales reports, inventory records, marketplace listings, and warehouse documentation. The role also involves investigating discrepancies, coordinating fulfillment-related concerns, supporting customer inquiries, and maintaining operational processes. Experience working with DTC brands, marketplace sellers, e-commerce agencies, or aggregators is highly relevant.



Key Responsibilities

- Prepare daily sales reports and recurring marketing and advertising performance reports using information from relevant business systems.

- Consolidate and review operational data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency across reports and records.

- Monitor inventory information across the company's direct-to-consumer website, marketplaces, and retail sales channels.

- Maintain product listings, inventory files, and product catalogs across platforms such as Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, and other retailer portals.

- Review marketplace inventory files and product information against approved records before submitting updates or uploads.

- Investigate discrepancies involving sales figures, inventory quantities, order transactions, and fulfillment records, and coordinate with relevant parties to resolve them.

- Coordinate with external warehouse and fulfillment partners regarding inventory counts, shipments, receiving records, returns, and other operational concerns.

- Review warehouse invoices and supporting documentation, verify charges against available business records, and follow up on discrepancies or disputed transactions.

- Assist with the preparation and verification of purchase orders, packing lists, shipping documents, and other operational paperwork.

- Support customer inquiries involving order status, shipments, refunds, returns, and warranty claims while maintaining timely and professional communication.

- Monitor customer reviews and outstanding support tickets, ensuring that customer concerns are properly addressed and followed through.

- Assist with preparing information and documentation for recurring production and operations meetings.

- Maintain operational spreadsheets, trackers, and reporting templates to ensure that business information remains organized and accessible.

- Document recurring workflows, maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and accuracy.

- Support the implementation of approved systems, marketplace integrations, and operational automations as needed.



Qualifications and Requirements



- At least 2 years of professional experience in e-commerce operations, DTC operations, marketplace management, inventory management, or a related operational function.

- Demonstrated experience working with operational data, including sales reports, inventory records, orders, invoices, or fulfillment information.

- Hands-on experience reconciling information from multiple sources and investigating discrepancies.

- Practical experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and Amazon Seller Central, particularly product listing management, inventory updates, and marketplace administration.

- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookup functions, data validation, and reconciliation trackers.

- Experience working with inventory management, ERP, or order management systems.

- Familiarity with warehouse operations, third-party logistics (3PL), inventory movements, and fulfillment documentation.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple operational responsibilities.

- Demonstrated initiative, independent problem-solving abilities, and consistent follow-through.

- Previous experience working remotely and the ability to maintain productivity in a remote working environment.



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following areas will be an advantage:



- Working with DTC brands, e-commerce agencies, marketplace sellers, or e-commerce aggregators.

- NetSuite or other ERP and inventory management systems.

- Amazon flat files and retailer vendor portals.

- Mirakl or other marketplace management platforms.

- EDI systems and integrations.

- ShipStation and shipping or fulfillment management tools.

- ESP and SAGE product catalogs.

- Purchase order management, packing lists, and carton planning.

- Direct coordination with third-party logistics providers and external warehouses.

- Customer service operations involving refunds, returns, and warranty claims.





How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume highlighting your experience in e-commerce operations, inventory management, reporting, and marketplace administration. Answers to the questions below are also required. 

1. How many years of professional experience do you have in e-commerce, DTC, or online retail operations?

2. Do you have experience handling operational reporting, inventory management, or general e-commerce operations? Please briefly describe your relevant experience.

3. What companies, industries, or platforms have you previously worked with that are relevant to this position?



Applications that demonstrate relevant hands-on experience and a strong understanding of operational accuracy will be prioritized.

title: School Liason
description:
School Liaison & Visits Coordinator

ED-SG · Remote Singapore Full-time 

Reports to: [Irene Wong



About ED-SG

ED-SG helps families relocating internationally find the right-fit international school. We work across Asia and the Gulf, with Singapore and Dubai at the centre of what we do.



We charge families directly and take no commissions from schools, so our guidance stays independent. Our work depends on strong, trusted relationships with the schools themselves.



The role

You will be the main point of contact between ED-SG and the international schools we work with.



When a family is weighing up schools, you make the visits happen. You check availability, book the tours, plan the route between campuses, and make sure parents arrive at the right place, at the right time, with the right information.



You will also build a working knowledge of each school’s programmes, so our consultants can give families accurate, current answers.



What you will do

School communication



Act as ED-SG’s primary contact with admissions teams at international schools in Singapore, Dubai and the other markets we serve

Request and confirm tour slots, open days, assessment dates and meetings with admissions staff

Find out specific programme information when a family needs it: curricula (IB, A-Levels, IGCSE, AP, US), learning support, language programmes, co-curricular activities, class sizes, waitlists and intake dates

Keep school contacts and correspondence up to date in our CRM (HubSpot)

Build and maintain professional, positive relationships with admissions teams

Scheduling and logistics



Build school visit itineraries for families, often three to five schools in a single day

Plan realistic timings that account for travel between campuses, traffic and buffer time

Coordinate across time zones, since parents are often still overseas when visits are booked

Send clear confirmations to consultants and families, and handle changes and cancellations quickly

Keep a shared calendar of all upcoming visits accurate and current

Programme knowledge



Learn the curricula and programmes offered at the schools we work with, and keep that knowledge current

Spot changes such as new programmes, fee updates or revised intake dates, and flag them to the consultant team

Help maintain our school profiles so the whole team works from accurate information

What you will bring

At least [two] years’ experience in a coordination, scheduling, admissions, executive assistant or client-service role

Excellent organisation: you are comfortable managing many moving parts, deadlines and people at once

Clear, professional written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail: dates, times, names and addresses are always right

A genuine appetite to learn, as you will become fluent in international curricula over time

Comfort working across Singapore (GMT+8) and Dubai (GMT+4) hours

Confidence with shared calendars,
 and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

Nice to have



Experience in international education, school admissions or relocation services

Local knowledge of Singapore or Dubai: the geography, traffic patterns and school landscape

Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM

Additional languages, for example Mandarin, Arabic, Japanese or Korean

title: AI Video Face Swap Specialist | Remote Part-Time | Flexible Hours
description:
# We're Hiring: AI Video Face Swap Specialist



We are a growing international digital talent management agency looking for a skilled **AI Video Face Swap Specialist** to join our creative team.



We need someone who knows how to create highly realistic AI face swaps in short-form videos for Instagram Reels and other social media platforms.



**This is NOT a full-time job.** We care about results, quality, and consistency — not how many hours you spend working.



### Your Main Responsibilities



- Take short Instagram-style videos provided by our team.

- Replace the original person's face with another model's face using AI technology.

- Create highly realistic and natural-looking face swaps.

- Keep the original video exactly the same, except for the facial identity.

- Preserve the original clothing, body, hairstyle, background, movements, lighting, and text.

- Deliver approximately **5–6 short videos per day (around 40 videos per week)**.

- Ensure consistent quality across all videos.



All source videos and facial references will be provided by our team, with the necessary permissions for editing and commercial use.



### What We're Looking For



- Experience with AI video face swapping.

- Knowledge of tools such as FaceFusion, Higgsfield, AKOOL, DeepFaceLab, or similar AI software.

- Ability to create realistic facial replacements without changing the original video.

- Attention to detail and consistent output quality.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



**You do not need to know every AI tool.** We are looking for someone who can consistently deliver excellent results using whichever professional tools work best.



### Work Schedule



- 100% remote.

- Part-time, flexible hours.

- Approximately 40 short videos per week.

- No fixed 8-hour shifts.

- Work whenever you want, as long as deadlines and quality standards are met.



### What We Offer



- Long-term collaboration with a growing international agency.

- Flexible working hours.

- Consistent weekly workload.

- Opportunity to grow with our creative team.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and output quality.



### How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Which AI face swap tools you have experience using.

3. Examples of realistic AI video face swaps you have previously created, with permission to share them.

4. Your expected monthly salary or price per completed video.

5. Your estimated turnaround time for 5–6 short videos.



**IMPORTANT:** We are specifically looking for FACE SWAP specialists, not general AI video creators.



We do not want AI-generated videos that change the original person's clothes, body, or background. We need precise facial replacements while preserving the original footage.



If you have experience producing realistic AI face swaps and want a flexible, long-term remote opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview

title: Functional Consultant (ERP / Odoo preferred)
description:
# Functional Consultant / Business Analyst (ERP / Odoo)



We're helping a small but growing Canadian consulting company find a **Functional Consultant / Business Analyst** to join their remote team.



The company helps small to mid-sized businesses improve their operations by fixing inefficient processes, organizing their systems, and implementing ERP solutions, primarily Odoo.



We're looking for someone who understands both **business processes and how systems work**. Someone who can speak with stakeholders, understand their problems, figure out what needs to change, and work with technical teams to make it happen.



This isn't a coding role. It's more about understanding the business, translating requirements into practical solutions, and making sure everything works as intended.



### What you'll be doing



- Understand business processes and gather requirements from stakeholders.

- Map workflows, identify problems, and recommend improvements.

- Translate business needs into clear requirements for developers.

- Help implement and improve ERP systems, primarily Odoo.

- Test solutions, conduct demos, and help users understand new processes.

- Manage your assigned work, follow up on open items, and see things through to completion.



### Who we're looking for



- At least 2 years of experience as a Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, or similar role.

- Experience with ERP systems. Odoo is preferred, but SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics, or similar systems are welcome.

- Good understanding of business operations such as inventory, purchasing, sales, or finance.

- Comfortable with process mapping, documentation, and understanding how systems connect.

- Good communication skills, including speaking directly with clients when needed.

- Someone organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently.



**One thing worth highlighting:** The team is small, so they're looking for someone who takes ownership rather than someone who needs constant instructions. You should be comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, and following through until problems are resolved.



### Work setup



- Fully remote, Philippines-based preferred

- Flexible working hours

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- Long-term opportunity with a growing company

- Work directly with an experienced founder and a small team



### Interested?



Please send us your updated resume along with your answers to the screening questions:



1) Have you worked for an ERP consulting firm, implementation partner, or a company that provides consulting services to multiple clients? Or has your experience been mainly in-house, supporting one company's systems? Please briefly describe the companies you've worked for and the type of clients or businesses you supported.



2) Which best describes your experience: Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, Technical Consultant/Developer, or a mix of these? What were you personally responsible for? For example, gathering requirements, process mapping, solution design, configuration, development, testing, training, or go-live support. etc.



3) Client Markets & Exposure: Have you supported clients or businesses in the US, Canada, Australia, Europe, or other international markets? Or has your experience been mainly with Philippine companies?



If mainly local, were you part of an internal ERP/IT team in a larger organization or working with external clients?



4) ERP Projects & Implementations

What ERP systems have you worked with, and what types of projects have you handled (new implementations, migrations, integrations, process improvements, etc.)?



Please mention the industries you've supported, the modules or business functions involved, and your specific contribution to these projects.



*Additional details about the company and opportunity will be shared with candidates who progress through our initial screening.*

title: Property Management VA – Buildium Experience Preferred (Part-Time, Long-Term Growth)
description:
We are a privately owned real estate investment and development company based in Columbus, Ohio, USA, seeking an experienced, reliable, and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage the administrative operations of our own residential and commercial rental property portfolio.



We currently own and operate approximately 60 rental units and recently purchased Buildium property management software. We manage our own properties and do not provide third-party property management services at this time. 



Buildium experience is strongly preferred, particularly experience with initial software setup, tenant and lease management, maintenance coordination, rent tracking, and financial reporting.



We are looking for someone who can independently manage our back-office operations, communicate professionally with tenants and contractors, maintain accurate records, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Assist with initial Buildium setup, including properties, units, tenants, leases, and financial information.

- Maintain accurate tenant ledgers, lease records, invoices, and property information.

- Record rent payments, monitor outstanding balances, and assist with delinquency tracking.

- Monitor and respond to tenant communications and maintenance requests.

- Coordinate repairs with our established local maintenance contractors and follow up until completion.

- Escalate urgent issues and matters requiring ownership approval.

- Assist with tenant onboarding, lease renewals, and move-out coordination.

- Organize property documents, vendor invoices, and financial records.

- Prepare weekly summaries of rent collections, maintenance requests, and outstanding issues.

- Assist with residential and commercial lease administration.

- Help develop efficient administrative processes as our portfolio grows.



QUALIFICATIONS



- Hands-on Buildium experience strongly preferred.

- Previous experience supporting U.S.-based residential property owners or property management companies.

- Familiarity with tenant communications, maintenance coordination, rent accounting, and property management operations.

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and solve problems without constant supervision.

- Reliable internet connection and professional remote working environment.

- Commercial property experience, NNN lease administration, and bookkeeping experience are pluses.



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



This is initially a part-time position requiring approximately 10–20 hours per week, with an expected starting workload of approximately 15 hours.



Ideally, the candidate will provide administrative support Monday through Friday, with brief check-ins on Saturdays and Sundays (approximately 15–30 minutes per day) to monitor tenant communications and maintenance requests.



Weekend responsibilities will generally be minimal, with additional working time compensated as needed. Emergency maintenance is handled through a separate local contractor escalation procedure.



Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours is preferred.



Compensation is approximately $6–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



LONG-TERM GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



Our current portfolio consists of approximately 60 rental units, with plans to add approximately 105 additional units within the next 18–24 months. Additional acquisitions could eventually bring our portfolio above 200 units.



We are seeking someone interested in a long-term working relationship, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time role overseeing the administrative operations of our growing rental portfolio.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. How much experience do you have using Buildium? What specific tasks have you performed independently?

2. Have you worked with U.S.-based property owners or property management companies? Approximately how many rental units did you help manage?

3. Have you helped set up a new Buildium account or migrate existing property, tenant, lease, and financial information?

4. Describe your experience with tenant communications, maintenance coordination, rent payments, and delinquency tracking.

5. Do you have experience with commercial rental properties, NNN leases, or tenant expense reimbursements?

6. What is your desired hourly rate in USD?

7. How many hours per week are you available? Are you comfortable with brief weekend check-ins?

8. Are you available for some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours?

9. Are you interested in potentially transitioning into a full-time position as our portfolio grows?



PRACTICAL SCENARIO



A tenant submits a maintenance request through Buildium stating that their furnace has stopped working during the winter. The property is located in Columbus, Ohio, and you are working remotely in the Philippines.



Briefly explain how you would handle this situation, including tenant communication, contractor coordination, escalation, and follow-up.



IMPORTANT: Please begin your application with the words "Buildium Property Management" so we know you have read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, proactive, and interested in becoming a valuable long-term member of our team.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Lifecycle Retention Email Manager (ECommerce) - Full Time, Remote
description:
We are looking for a strategic, analytical, and performance-driven Lifecycle Retention Email Manager to lead the development and optimization of our customer retention strategy across owned marketing channels. This role will focus on building meaningful customer relationships, increasing repeat purchases, improving customer lifetime value (LTV), and driving sustainable revenue growth across our skincare and hair care product lines.

You will own the customer lifecycle experience, developing personalized email and SMS journeys that engage customers at every stage—from their first interaction with our brand to repeat purchases and long-term loyalty. By combining customer insights, data-driven strategies, and compelling storytelling, you'll create retention programs that deliver value to our customers while supporting our broader business and brand goals.

 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Own the customer lifecycle and retention strategy across email and SMS, developing initiatives that drive customer engagement, repeat purchases, customer lifetime value, and long-term loyalty.

Develop, execute, and optimize lifecycle campaigns and automated flows across multiple product lines, including hair thinning shampoo, supplements, anti-aging SPF, and skincare supplements.

Build and manage high-performing customer journeys, including welcome series, cart abandonment, browse abandonment, post-purchase education, replenishment reminders, cross-sell and upsell campaigns, loyalty initiatives, and win-back sequences.

Develop advanced audience segmentation and personalization strategies based on customer behavior, purchase history, engagement, product preferences, and lifecycle stage.

Identify opportunities to improve retention, reduce customer churn, increase purchase frequency, and encourage customers to explore additional products within our portfolio.

Plan and execute A/B tests across messaging, subject lines, creative assets, offers, timing, and customer journeys to continuously improve campaign performance.

Monitor, analyze, and report on key retention and lifecycle metrics, including repeat purchase rate, customer lifetime value (LTV), retention rate, churn rate, click-through rate, conversion rate, and revenue per recipient.

Leverage customer feedback, surveys, and behavioral insights to better understand customer needs, identify retention opportunities, and inform marketing and product strategies.

Collaborate with creative, product, and customer experience teams to develop cohesive, engaging, and on-brand customer communications.

Maintain email and SMS marketing best practices and compliance, including CAN-SPAM and TCPA requirements.

Identify and implement new tools, technologies, and retention marketing strategies to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and overall channel performance.

 

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or customer retention, ideally within eCommerce, beauty, skincare, or wellness.

Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar marketing automation and CRM platforms.

Proven experience developing and optimizing automated lifecycle flows, retention campaigns, and customer segmentation strategies.

Strong understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, retention strategies, repeat purchase behavior, and customer lifetime value.

Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate campaign performance and customer insights into actionable strategies.

Excellent copywriting skills and a strong understanding of brand voice, customer psychology, and personalized marketing.

Experience with A/B testing, campaign analytics, and performance optimization.

Familiarity with tools such as Rebuy, product recommendation engines, loyalty platforms, or other eCommerce retention tools is a plus.

Highly organized, proactive, curious, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Passion for skincare, beauty, wellness, and helping people feel their best.

 

What You'll Help Shape

Your role goes beyond sending emails and managing campaigns—you'll help shape the entire customer experience and build lasting relationships with our audience.

You'll uncover what motivates customers to purchase, what keeps them coming back, and what opportunities exist to strengthen their connection with our brands. Through thoughtful lifecycle strategies, personalized communication, and data-driven experimentation, you'll help transform one-time buyers into loyal, repeat customers.

You'll also play an important role in bringing the voice of the customer into our business, turning feedback and behavioral insights into better customer experiences, smarter product recommendations, stronger retention initiatives, and more meaningful brand connections.

We're looking for someone who is part retention strategist, part lifecycle marketer, and part customer advocate.

 

Ready to Apply?

Send us:

Your resume

A brief note explaining why you'd be a great fit for this role

(Optional) Examples of lifecycle email campaigns, automated flows, or retention strategies you've developed and are proud of

We can't wait to meet someone who's just as passionate about skincare, customer connection, and building meaningful brand relationships as we are.

 

About Us

Orca Brands, the parent company of SRILabs, is dedicated to creating innovative, science-backed beauty and wellness products that deliver real results. With a strong and growing customer base, our mission is to provide high-quality solutions that enhance everyday lives.

 

At SRI, we focus on premium skincare and beauty tools, blending creativity, research, and customer insight to drive meaningful impact. We're passionate about delivering exceptional value, creating outstanding customer experiences, and building genuine, lasting connections with our audience.
