title: Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator
description:
Senior Creative Apparel Graphic Designer & Illustrator Custom Artwork /

Sports Apparel / Illustration / Seamless Patterns



$12–$20 USD/hour | Long-Term | Approximately 15–25 Hours/Week



We are looking for an exceptionally creative, senior-level graphic

designer and illustrator to join our team on an ongoing freelance basis.



CREATIVITY IS THE #1 REQUIREMENT FOR THIS ROLE.



This is not primarily a production design position. We are not looking

for someone who simply places logos on templates, follows detailed

instructions, or waits to be told exactly what to create.



We need an outstanding visual designer who can be given very limited

creative direction and develop the idea themselves.



Your primary responsibility will be creating custom artwork and product

graphics based on customer logos, brands, themes, and design requests.



A typical project may begin with nothing more than:



A customer’s logo + a few colors + a short sentence describing what they

want.



From there, you are the creative.



You will be expected to determine the visual direction and create the

patterns, illustrations, icons, typography, supporting graphics,

layouts, and other artwork necessary to turn that limited information

into an exceptional finished collection.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Interpret customer requests with very little creative direction

- Develop original visual concepts independently

- Create original graphics and artwork for apparel and other products

- Design cohesive collections across multiple products

- Determine how artwork should merchandise across different products

 rather than simply repeating the same design

- Create original vector illustrations, icons, badges, logos,

 typography, and supporting artwork

- Create sophisticated seamless repeating patterns

- Work with customer logos and existing brand assets

- Recreate low-resolution customer logos as clean vector artwork when

 necessary

- Develop artwork specifically for sublimated sports/performance

 apparel

- Adapt creative concepts across apparel, accessories, and other

 products

- Use AI intelligently to accelerate portions of the creative process

 when appropriate

- Take feedback well and quickly develop revised creative solutions



CREATIVITY IS ESSENTIAL



We cannot emphasize this enough.



We are looking for someone with excellent taste, strong visual

instincts, and the ability to generate ideas independently.



If you require detailed creative briefs, sketches, or step-by-step

instructions before you can begin designing, this will not be the right

position for you.



We want someone who can look at a customer’s brand, understand its

personality, and think:



“Here are five interesting directions we could take this.”



Not:



“What exactly would you like me to make?”



You should be comfortable making creative decisions yourself and

presenting strong solutions rather than waiting for someone else to

solve the creative problem for you.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Adobe Illustrator — EXPERT LEVEL



You must be an exceptional Adobe Illustrator user.



You should be able to work quickly and confidently with complex vector

artwork without assistance.



You must have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.



We will train you on our internal processes. We will not train you on

design software.



Illustration — STRONG/EXPERT



You must actually be able to illustrate.



This includes creating:



- Original vector graphics

- Icons

- Logos and badges

- Custom typography

- Mascots/characters when needed

- Graphic elements

- Pattern assets

- Supporting collection artwork



We are not looking for someone whose primary skill is arranging stock

assets.



Seamless Patterns — ABSOLUTELY REQUIRED



You must know how to professionally create seamless repeating patterns

in:



Adobe Illustrator AND Adobe Photoshop.



This is a core requirement of the position.



Sports / Sublimated Apparel Experience



You should have professional experience designing for sports,

performance, or sublimated apparel.



Experience with categories such as golf, cycling, running, outdoor, team

sports, or similar products is highly desirable.



You must understand how artwork interacts with garment panels and how to

design a collection that works across multiple product types.



AI EXPERIENCE



We actively use AI as a creative accelerator, and you should be

comfortable doing the same.



You should understand how to use modern AI creative tools to help:



- Explore concepts

- Generate reference material

- Develop supporting assets

- Accelerate illustration

- Explore compositions

- Generate ideas faster



However, the finished work cannot look AI-generated.



AI is a tool—not a substitute for design ability.



You must have the taste and technical ability to recognize poor AI

output, refine/rebuild assets when necessary, and turn generated ideas

into polished, professional artwork.



A great designer using AI should become faster and more capable, not

produce generic AI artwork.



THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



- Extremely creative

- A genuinely strong visual problem solver

- A senior-level designer, not someone still learning their craft

- An excellent illustrator

- Highly self-sufficient

- Fast in Adobe Illustrator

- Comfortable starting with very limited direction

- Able to take constructive feedback without becoming dependent on

 direction

- Capable of switching between completely different visual styles

- Excellent at color, typography, composition, and pattern

- Able to understand a brand quickly

- Organized and reliable

- Comfortable managing multiple custom projects

- Excited about making genuinely cool artwork



Creativity and portfolio quality matter more to us than years of

experience or formal education.



HOURS & COMPENSATION



This is intended to become a consistent, long-term working relationship.



Our target is approximately 25 hours per week at $12–$15 USD/hour,

depending on experience, speed, and portfolio quality.



However:



We are willing to pay up to $20 USD/hour for an exceptional designer,

even if that means fewer guaranteed weekly hours.



We would rather have 15–20 hours from an incredible designer than 25

hours from an average one.



During busy periods, there may also be opportunities to take on

additional projects/hours for additional compensation or performance

bonuses, based on availability.



PORTFOLIO REQUIRED — NO EXCEPTIONS



Do not apply without a portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



We especially want to see:



- Your most creative work

- Sports/performance apparel graphics

- Sublimated apparel

- Complete coordinated collections

- Seamless patterns

- Original vector illustration

- Logos, badges, and icons you personally created

- Projects where you developed the creative direction yourself



We are not particularly interested in portfolios dominated by social

media graphics, corporate presentations, UI/UX, Canva templates, or

generic branding projects.



We want to see ARTWORK.



TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Portfolio link — REQUIRED

2. Show us the 3 projects that best demonstrate how creative you are.

3. Show us a sports/apparel collection you personally designed.

4. Show us at least 2 seamless patterns you personally built and tell

 us what software you used to create them.

5. Show us examples of your original vector illustration work.

6. Describe your experience with sublimated apparel.

7. Tell us which AI creative tools you currently use and how they fit

 into your design process.

8. Confirm that you have your own licensed access to Adobe Illustrator.

9. Confirm your weekly availability and desired hourly rate.



FINAL CREATIVE QUESTION:



Imagine a customer gives you only their logo, brand colors, and the

words “retro tropical golf.” They want a collection but provide no

additional creative direction.



Briefly describe the first 3 visual concepts you would explore.



Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.

Facility & Provider Scheduling

1. Coordinate weekly patient visits across our network of facilities.

2. Process incoming faxes, referrals, and documents, routing them appropriately.

AI & Process Improvement

1. Learn and take ownership of our existing Claude-based scheduling workflow.

2. Use AI tools to improve scheduling, organization, and administrative efficiency.

3. Verify AI-generated outputs, troubleshoot issues, and improve existing workflows.

4. Maintain operational trackers, develop SOPs, and identify opportunities for automation.

5. Proactively recommend improvements that reduce administrative work for our providers.

- 3+ years of experience supporting U.S. healthcare practices in medical administration, scheduling, or patient coordination.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

- Experience with Practice Fusion or PointClickCare.

- Background in cardiology, nursing homes, assisted living, or rehabilitation facilities.

- Experience managing provider schedules, referrals, and shared inboxes.

- Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or Power Automate.

- Someone who thinks beyond a task list.

- If a facility hasn't sent its patient list, you follow up. If a consultation hasn't been scheduled, you investigate. If a provider's schedule has a conflict, you propose a solution. If a process is inefficient, you find a better way.

We provide commercial and office cleaning, janitorial services, post-construction cleaning, residential and deep cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, and Airbnb turnovers.

What you’ll do

.

• Log every call, outcome, and next step in our CRM. Update Jobber when needed and send a brief end-of-day report.

• Honor do-not-contact and unsubscribe requests immediately. Direct pricing and proposal questions to Jenny.

Our daily calling target is 150 unique call attempts, with each number counted once per day. We also track decisionmakers reached, qualified opportunities, appointments that take place, and new clients.

Tools and training

We provide CloudTalk and a U.S. business number for calls, Apollo for prospect research, our CRM for tracking leads and follow-ups, and Jobber for client and job records. You’ll also receive prospect lists, scripts, training, and a weekly review. The first 80 hours are a paid trial.

Schedule and pay

• Monday through Friday, 25 hours per week, during U.S. Eastern business hours.

• $3–$4 USD per hour, depending on experience, paid weekly through Wise.

• $10 for each qualified appointment or walkthrough you book that takes place.

Each signed contract earns one bonus based on its monthly value: $30 up to $2,000.00 monthly contract value, $70 over $2,000 and Under $3,000; $75 monthly contract $3,000 or more.

Contract bonuses are paid after HanoHano receives payment on the first invoice.

What we’re looking for

• Previous experience in cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or B2B sales. Experience calling U.S. businesses is strongly preferred. Cleaning, janitorial, or facilities sales experience is a plus.

• Clear spoken and written English and a confident, natural phone manner.

• The ability to get through a front desk, handle objections professionally, and follow up without reminders.

• Accurate CRM notes and reliable daily reporting.

• A reliable computer, headset, stable internet, and a quiet workspace. Experience with Apollo, CloudTalk, Jobber, or similar tools is a plus.

How to apply

Use this subject line: HanoHano VA – [Your First Name]

1. Share your name and location.

2. Describe your cold calling, lead generation, or appointment setting experience. Include your typical daily call volume and a result you’re proud of.

3. Tell us which U.S. businesses or industries you’ve called.

4. List the CRMs, dialers, and prospecting tools you’ve used.

5. Share your internet speed and any backup internet or power setup.

6. Confirm your availability Monday through Friday in U.S. Eastern Time.

7. Include a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself as if you were speaking with a U.S. business prospect. Use a link we can open without signing in.

8. Answer in your own words: You call a property management company and the receptionist says, “We already have a cleaning company.” What would you say next?



We’ll invite shortlisted applicants to a brief live role-play. We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with HanoHano and build a long-term working relationship.



Applications close Wednesday, November 18, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. Philippine time. I’ll contact finalists by Friday, November 20 to schedule a 10-minute live role-play.

title: Senior Technical Designer (Tech Packs, Fashion + Accessories)
description:
EXPERIENCED ONLY: please read before applying



You must have ALL THREE of these. If you don't, please don't apply.

1.  Fashion industry experience as a technical designer and CAN SKETCH! 

2.  Tech packs you have made yourself for accessories (bags, pouches, small leather goods), which you can show us

3.  Strong knowledge of trims and hardware (zips, buckles, rivets, webbing, labels, finishes)

4. Do not use Ai to apply, real personality, and creativity is valued in our company! Anyone who send anything that feels Ai or inauthentic, generic wont be responded to. 



This is not an entry-level or training role. Applications without fashion experience and real accessories tech packs will be declined without a reply.





About the role

We are a premium Australian gardening lifestyle brand, . We make garden related products for people who garden and care how they look doing it.

Our range is growing, and we need a freelance technical designer to turn our ideas into drawings and tech packs a factory can make without guessing.



Our founder brings the vision for each product: a mood board, reference images, written notes and a voice note on how it should feel and what it is for. You turn that into clean technical flats and a complete tech pack. 



Our Product Development Assistant then takes it to the factory and manages sampling, with you reviewing each sample alongside her.



This is partime role, paid per hour, starting at around one day a week. There is room to grow as the range does.



What you'll do

• Read each product brief properly and send clarifying questions before you start

• Draw technical flats in Adobe Illustrator (or similar): front, back, side and close-ups of key details

• Build full tech packs: measurements and tolerances, bill of materials (BOM), fabrics and trims, hardware, Pantone colour references, construction and stitching notes, label and logo placement, and packaging notes

• Suggest practical ways to make a design manufacturable, and flag cost or construction problems early

• Review factory samples against the tech pack: mark up photos, write clear revision comments and update the tech pack for each round

• Keep a tidy, version-controlled library of tech packs and templates in our shared Google Drive

What we're looking for

• Proven experience as a technical designer in fashion, with tech packs for accessories (bags, pouches, small leather goods) and apparel

• Strong knowledge of trims and hardware: zips, buckles, rivets, webbing, piping, labels, threads and finishes, and how to specify them so a factory gets them right

• Strong Adobe Illustrator skills for technical flats (CAD experience welcome)

• A working knowledge of materials, construction, hardware and how factories read a tech pack

• Very detail-minded: measurements, tolerances and specs are your home ground

• Clear written English, and confident asking questions when something is unclear

• Reliable internet and a few hours a week of overlap with Australian business hours

• Experience with Techpacker, Backbone or another tech pack tool is a plus

• Experience working with factories in China or elsewhere in Asia is a plus

• An eye for good design, and an interest in fashion, gardens or country life, is very welcome



What we don't want

We care most about original thinking. If your approach is to copy what already exists, or to lean on AI to produce drawings and specs rather than understanding how a product is made, this isn't the role for you. We want someone who reads a brief, brings their own eye for proportion and detail, and tells us honestly when something won't work and what would.





To apply



Please include:

1.  A portfolio showing at least two complete tech packs you have made (flats plus spec sheets). Screenshots or PDFs are fine.

2.  A short Loom video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself and walking us through one of those tech packs

3.  Your hourly rate 

4.  Your availability each week





Please start your application with the words "Garden Tech Designer" so we know you've read this far.

title: Graphic & Multimedia Designer
description:
*About the Role 



We are looking for a talented and versatile Graphic & Multimedia Designer to join our creative team and support the visual needs of a growing digital marketing and web agency. 



This role is ideal for a creative professional who is confident in both graphic design and video editing and understands how strong visual content supports branding, advertising, social media, websites, and overall marketing performance. 



The right candidate should have strong design fundamentals, excellent visual judgment, and hands-on experience creating professional graphics, branded content, social media assets, digital advertisements, short-form videos, promotional videos, and other multimedia materials. 



You should be comfortable working across multiple brands and industries, adapting to different visual styles, following brand guidelines, and producing polished work that is both creative and effective. 



AI tools may be used as part of a modern workflow for brainstorming, research, ideation, or productivity support. However, this role requires genuine design ability, strong creative judgment, originality, and confidence using professional creative software. 



*Key Responsibilities 



Create high-quality visual assets for websites, landing pages, social media, paid advertising, email campaigns, presentations, and print materials. 



Design graphics for Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram content, Google Display ads, website banners, blog graphics, thumbnails, flyers, brochures, and other marketing collateral.

, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other digital channels.

Develop and support brand identity systems, including logos, color palettes, typography selections, visual styles, and brand guidelines.

Collaborate with marketing, content, social media, and web development teams to create visuals that support campaign objectives.

Maintain consistency across visual assets for different clients and brands. 



Prepare production-ready files for both digital and print use. 



Maintain organized design and video project files using proper naming, storage, and version-control practices. 



Review feedback and make revisions efficiently while maintaining high creative standards. 



Manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. 



Stay current with graphic design trends, video editing styles, social media creative formats, paid advertising standards, and evolving multimedia tools. 



*Required Qualifications 



Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Multimedia Designer, Visual Designer, Video Editor, or in a similar creative role. 



Strong portfolio demonstrating professional work across graphic design, branding, digital marketing, social media, advertising, and video editing. 



Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including: 



-Layout 

-Visual hierarchy 

-Typography 

-Color theory 

-Composition 

-Spacing 

-Brand consistency 

-Visual storytelling 



Strong understanding of video editing fundamentals, including: 



-Pacing 

-Story flow 

-Transitions 

-Audio balance 

-Captions and text overlays 

-Basic color correction 

-Video formatting for social platforms 



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly: 



-Adobe Photoshop 

-Adobe Illustrator 

-Adobe InDesign 



Experience with at least one professional video editing platform, such as: 



Adobe Premiere Pro 

Adobe After Effects 

CapCut 

DaVinci Resolve 

Final Cut Pro 

Similar video editing software 



-Ability to create original visual concepts and assets from scratch. 

-Experience designing for digital marketing campaigns, including Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram graphics, Google Display ads, social media content, and website imagery. 

-Experience editing short-form video content for social media and digital advertising. 

-Ability to follow brand guidelines while adapting creatively across multiple clients and industries. 

-Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, client-ready work. 

-Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines efficiently. 

-Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

-Ability to receive and apply creative feedback professionally. 



*Preferred Qualifications 



-Experience working in a digital marketing agency, web agency, advertising agency, or creative agency. 

-Experience with Canva for creating editable templates and client-facing assets. 

-Experience with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar collaborative design tools. 

-Basic understanding of website design, responsive layouts, and UX/UI best practices. 

-Experience developing complete brand identity packages and visual systems. 

-Experience creating social media ad campaigns and landing page graphics. 

-Experience producing video advertisements and promotional videos. 

-Experience with motion graphics and basic animation. 

-Familiarity with Adobe After Effects is a strong plus. 

-Experience adding subtitles, captions, lower thirds, animated text, and branded motion elements. 

-Basic understanding of audio editing and sound selection. 

-Experience creating thumbnails and supporting assets for YouTube or other video platforms. 

-Experience preparing artwork for professional print production. 

-Experience designing for a variety of industries, audiences, and client types. 



*AI Tool Expectations 



We support the responsible use of AI tools as part of a modern creative workflow, but this role is not intended for someone who depends on AI to perform the core creative work. 



AI may be used for: 



-Brainstorming 

-Concept exploration 

-Research 

-Mood boards 

-Script or content ideation 

-Workflow support 

-Productivity assistance 



Final work should demonstrate strong human creative judgment, originality, brand awareness, visual consistency, and professional execution. 



Candidates should be comfortable creating high-quality graphics and multimedia content independently using professional design and editing tools. 



*What We Are Looking For 



We are looking for someone who can:

title: LMMG Part-Time Bookkeeper
description:
Last Mountain Management Group is hiring a part-time Bookkeeper to support our nonprofit clients, working 4 hours a day on Central Time at $6 per hour, with more hours as our client load grows.



ROLE SNAPSHOT

Position: Part Time Bookkeeper, Nonprofit Clients

Location: Remote, Philippines based

Schedule: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, during Central Time (CST) business hours

Start date: November 25, 2026

Pay: $6 USD per hour

Reports to: Internal Fractional CFO, with direct collaboration with the Owner

Growth: Additional hours and clients as our portfolio expands



ABOUT US

Last Mountain Management Group, LLC (LMMG) is a Texas based business management consulting firm. We provide bookkeeping, fractional CFO, and operations support to nonprofits and small organizations so their leaders can focus on mission and impact.



Our team is small, remote, and closely connected. Most of our team works from the Philippines on Central Time, and we care about clean books, clear communication, and steady, reliable work.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will keep the books for a set of nonprofit clients, working directly with one of our internal Fractional CFOs and our Owner. Your CFO will onboard you to each client, review your work, and be your go to person day to day.



This role starts at 4 hours a day. As we bring on more clients, we expect to offer more hours and more client responsibility to bookkeepers who show accuracy and consistency.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Record and categorize daily transactions in QuickBooks Online for each assigned nonprofit client.

2. Complete monthly bank and credit card reconciliations on schedule.

3. Code income and expenses to the correct programs, funds, and classes, including restricted and unrestricted funds.

4. Track grants and donor restricted contributions so balances and releases stay accurate.

5. Process bills, deposits, and receipts, and keep supporting documents organized.

6. Prepare month end close items and draft financial reports for CFO review.

7. Support the CFO with audit preparation, Form 990 preparation, and client cleanups as needed.

8. Flag unusual items, missing documents, or questions to your CFO quickly and clearly.

9. Log your time accurately by client in Clockify and keep task status current in ClickUp.

10. Communicate with the team through ClickUp during your scheduled hours.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Required

1. At least 2 years of bookkeeping experience.

2. Hands on experience with QuickBooks Online.

3. Strong working knowledge of bank reconciliations, accruals, and month end close.

4. Ability to work 4 consistent hours a day within Central Time (CST) business hours.

5. Clear written and spoken English.

6. A reliable computer and stable internet connection, with a backup plan for outages.

7. High attention to detail and a habit of double checking your work.



Preferred

1. Knowledge of GAAP standards, especially nonprofit accounting (ASC 958).

2. Experience with nonprofit or fund accounting, including restricted funds and grant tracking.

3. Familiarity with audit preparation or Form 990 support.

4. Experience working with US based clients.

5. Comfort with Google Workspace, ClickUp, and Clockify.

6. Accounting degree or bookkeeping certification.



SCHEDULE, PAY, AND GROWTH

Schedule. You will work 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, in a set block within Central Time business hours. Your exact block will be agreed with your CFO. Please note this falls overnight in the Philippines (for example, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Central is 11:00 PM to 3:00 AM Philippine Time from November to March, and 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM from March to November when the US observes Daylight Saving Time).



Start Date. We are looking for someone who can start on November 25, 2026.



Pay. $6 USD per hour, paid for hours tracked in Clockify. At 4 hours a day, that is about $520 USD per month.



Growth. We are growing our client roster. Bookkeepers who deliver accurate, on time work will be first in line for additional hours, additional clients, and expanded responsibilities.



HOW TO APPLY

Please begin your
 subject line with the words "Restricted Funds" so we know you read the full post. Then send the following to 

1. Your resume.

2. A short note on your bookkeeping experience, including any nonprofit or GAAP work.

3. In 2 or 3 sentences, in your own words, the difference between net assets with donor restrictions and net assets without donor restrictions.

4. The QuickBooks Online tasks you are most comfortable with.

5. Confirmation that you can work 4 hours a day within Central Time business hours.

6. Confirmation that you can start on November 25, 2026, or your earliest available start date.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
About the Role 



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked—this role may be for you. 



Rohring Results is a US-based marketing agency providing SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development for clients across multiple industries. 



We are hiring a Strategy Manager to own the strategic direction behind our client work. 



This is not a single-channel marketing role. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan. 



More importantly: 



This is a research job with a strategy title. 



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it. 



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem. 



What You'll Actually Do 



1. Lead Client Strategy 



-You will own the strategy for new clients, including: 

-Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction 

-Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan 

-Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities 

-Determining what should be prioritized and why 

-Translating research into clear strategic recommendations 

-Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives 



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research 



-You will personally conduct or direct research involving: 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Customer personas 

-Competitive analysis 

-Industry and market research 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research for paid campaigns 

-Competitor messaging and offer analysis 

-Market trends and opportunities 



We are looking for someone who actually does the research, not someone who simply delegates it. 



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable. 



3. Build Brand Foundations 



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning. 



You will help establish: 



-Brand positioning 

-Differentiation 

-Target audience 

-Brand voice 

-Key messaging 

-Value propositions 

-Messaging angles 



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables. 



You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why. 



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative 



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client. 



You will: 



-Review content and creative deliverables 

-Identify when something does not align with strategy 

-Give clear and actionable feedback 

-Approve or reject work before client delivery 

-Explain why something needs to change 

-Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy 



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it. 



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy 



You will determine: 



-Target audience 

-Campaign objective 

-Offer 

-Messaging angle 

-Sequence 

-Call to action 



Our copywriter will write the
s. 



You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work. 



6. Analyze Client Performance 



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools. 



But generating a report is only the beginning. 



You will need to determine: 



-What actually happened? 

-Why did it happen? 

-Which numbers matter? 

-Which numbers are misleading? 

-What changed from the previous period? 

-What should we do next? 

-Does the data actually support the story the report is telling? 

-We need someone who can question the report, not just format it. 



AI Is a Major Part of This Role 



Every agency says it uses AI. 



Here's what we actually mean. 



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different. 



Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong. 



You will be expected to: 



-Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries 

-Build effective prompts and research workflows 

-Iterate instead of accepting the first response 

-Cross-check AI-generated information 

-Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations 

-Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know 

-Know when AI should not be used 

-Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate 

-Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources 

-Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true. 



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly. 



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that looked correct but wasn't—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it. 



What You'll Own 



-Overall marketing strategy for new clients 

-Integrated multi-channel strategy 

-Market and industry research 

-Buyer and audience research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Brand positioning and differentiation 

-Customer personas 

-Paid advertising audience strategy 

-Content and creative direction 

-Content and creative approval 


 campaign strategy 

-Client performance reporting 

-Strategic recommendations based on performance data 

-Ongoing independent research 

-Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks 

-Dedicated Research Time 



A portion of every week will be protected for research that is not tied to a specific client. 



This is intentional. 



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities. 



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output. 



That's the point. 



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable. 



 

What We're Looking For 



Required 



Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience 



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including: 



-SEO 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Social Media 

-Content Marketing 


 Marketing 

-Brand Strategy 



We are not looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others. 



Strong Research Experience 



You have personally conducted work such as: 



-Market research 

-Competitive analysis 

-Customer research 

-Personas 

-Brand positioning 

-Audience research 

-Industry analysis 



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail. 



Genuine Curiosity 

One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity. 

We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it. 

It does not have to be marketing. 

Strong AI Research Skills 

You understand AI as a research and reasoning instrument, not simply a faster way to write. 



You should be comfortable: 

-Prompting 

-Iterating 

-Fact-checking 

-Comparing sources 

-Challenging AI outputs 

-Building repeatable AI research workflows 



We may assess this skill live. 



Strong Critical Thinking 



You naturally ask: 



-How do we know this? 

-What is the source? 

-What assumption are we making? 

-What would prove this wrong? 

-Is there another explanation? 

-What information are we missing? 

-Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback 



You will have authority over work produced by other team members. 



You need to be comfortable saying: 



“This isn't right yet.” 



More importantly, you need to explain exactly what needs to change and why. 



-Self-Directed 

-Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline. 

-You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next. 

-Communication 

-Excellent written English 

-Strong analytical communication 

-Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues 

-Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly 

-Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions 



 



Nice to Have 



Experience with: 

-Digital marketing agencies 

-Google Ads 

-Meta Ads 

-Paid audience and targeting strategy 

-Google Search Console 

-GA4 

-SEO platforms and analytics 

-Marketing dashboards and reporting 

-Competitive intelligence 

-Brand strategy 

-Marketing automation 

-AI research workflows 

-Creating documented processes that another person can follow 



 

What This Job Is NOT 



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for: 



A content writing position 



An SEO specialist position 



A paid ads specialist position 



A social media manager position 



A role where someone else provides the strategy 



A position where you simply execute instructions 



A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster 



Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute. 



You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working. 



 

About the Working Environment 



This is a senior individual contributor position. 



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority. 



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval. 



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered. 



Our delivery team primarily works on Philippine hours, including daily stand-ups. 



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process. 



 



How to Apply 



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following: 



1. A Research Question You Answered Well 



Tell us: 



What were you trying to find out? 



How did you conduct the research? 



What sources did you use? 



How did you evaluate the information? 



How did you know your conclusion was reliable? 



What decision did the research ultimately influence? 



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer 



Tell us about a situation where: 



An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable 



You discovered that it was wrong or misleading 



Explain how you identified the problem 



Explain how you verified the correct information 



Explain what you changed in your process afterward 



We read these answers before the rest of the application. 



Send to 



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.

description:
Love building software that a real business runs on? Enjoy working with AI coding agents and owning the result? Want to be our first developer, with a path to lead, at a company that cares about people and the planet? 



If you said yes, keep reading! 



First up: we want this to be a great place to work. That's our commitment to everyone on our team. It won't always be easy, but it will be fulfilling. You'll grow personally and professionally, surrounded by a team that genuinely cares about our mission and about helping each other get there. 



Starting with the perks 

• Monthly salary range: PHP 140,000 to 200,000, based on experience 

• 13th month bonus 

• Quarterly performance bonus* 

• Health insurance (HMO)** 

• PH public holidays converted to annual leave credits 

• Volunteer and training leave 

• Ongoing training and development, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 

• Work from home 

• P&R AI coding tools and work accounts provided 

• First dibs on P&R merch!

• And of course, monthly supply of P&R coffee, sent to you ☕️



*After your first three month term. 

**After 1 year of tenure.



A little about you 



You've built web apps end to end and shipped them. You're strong in TypeScript, React, Node and PostgreSQL, and you've connected apps to outside systems and kept them matched. You use AI coding tools every day and you know when their output is wrong. You write clearly, you work well on your own, and you want to own the result. 



About us 



Pablo & Rusty's is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, with a mission to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We roast for about 260 cafes, our own cafes in Sydney and Brisbane, online customers and retail partners. We're one of the few coffee companies in Australia that are B Corp certified, Carbon Neutral and members of 1% for the Planet. We're a digital, design centric and sustainable company. Innovation drives everything we do. 



About the role 



We're building our own business apps, one at a time, beside our accounting system. You'll be our first developer, working directly with our CEO, with a path to lead developer as the team grows. 



Key duties and responsibilities: 



• Take over and finish our finance app: reading supplier invoices with Azure AI, a review queue, and posting bills to MYOB through its API 

• Build our CRM web app and phone app, which replace Zendesk Sell in 2027 

• Write the sync between our apps and MYOB, Zendesk Sell, Microsoft 365 and later Business Central 

• Set up and look after CI, deployment and monitoring on Azure 

• Build AI into our apps, such as agents that read supplier invoices and code them to accounts 

• Design and write code yourself, and use AI coding agents to work faster: you set the tasks, review their pull requests and own the result 



Qualifications and knowledge: 

• Six or more years building web apps, with at least three years of TypeScript on front end (React) and back end (Node) 

• Strong SQL and PostgreSQL 

• Real integration work with outside APIs: OAuth, webhooks, retries and reconciliation 

• Cloud deployment, ideally Azure, with CI and infrastructure as code 

• Good written English and serious use of AI coding tools 

• Some experience building AI features with LLM APIs such as Claude or Azure OpenAI 

• A plus: MYOB, Xero or Business Central integrations, document AI, MCP servers, Rust, React Native 



Work schedule 



Full time, about 40 hours a week, set by you. Please be online for four hours each weekday for calls and reviews, usually 10 am to 2 pm Sydney time (7 am to 11 am Philippine time from October to April, 8 am to 12 pm from April to October). You'll need your own reliable computer, stable high speed internet and a backup connection and power source. 



Start: December 2026 or early January 2027. 



How we hire 

A short call, a technical conversation about your past work, then a paid task of about half a day, at a fee we agree first. 



Sound like your cup of coffee? 

Send us your resume, a link to code you wrote (a repo or a live app) and a short cover letter! 



P.S. If you've read this far, we'd love you to answer this in your cover letter: tell us about an integration you built and what went wrong. And what's your go to coffee order?

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Cleaning & Junk Removal Services
description:
We are looking for an experienced, sales-driven representative to handle inbound leads for our

cleaning and junk removal services.



Customers contact us through our website, phone,
, or chat because they are interested in

booking a service. Your responsibility is to turn these inquiries into paying customers by

understanding their needs, preparing quotes, handling objections, and closing sales.



Beyond sales, you will also manage the coordination process by sourcing local service

providers, arranging schedules, and monitoring jobs through completion.



This is a hands-on role that combines sales, customer communication, and vendor coordination.



Responsibilities

● Respond to inbound inquiries through phone, website,
, and chat.

● Understand customer requirements, including service scope, exact address, and

preferred service date and time.

● Prepare and provide quotes based on the customer's needs.

● Explain pricing, handle objections, and close sales.

● Follow up with interested leads who have not yet booked.

● Maintain accurate lead and customer records in our CRM.

● Find local cleaning companies, junk removal providers, and service teams to fulfill

booked jobs.

● Contact providers to confirm service availability, coverage, and pricing.

● Coordinate schedules between customers and service providers.

● Communicate job requirements and special instructions to the assigned service teams.

● Monitor jobs from booking through completion, keeping both customers and providers

updated.

● Resolve scheduling issues, delays, and service concerns as they arise.



Requirements

● Previous sales experience is required.

● Proven ability to convert inbound leads into paying customers.

● Experience in cleaning, junk removal, home services, construction, landscaping, moving,

or similar industries is a plus.

● Excellent spoken and written English.

● Confident phone communication and strong objection-handling skills.

● Comfortable discussing prices, preparing quotes, negotiating, and closing sales.

● Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.

● Experience coordinating with vendors, contractors, or service providers is an advantage.

● Able to manage multiple leads and ongoing jobs independently.

● Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools.

● Reliable internet connection and professional working environment.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.

A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be

worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer,

addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to

move forward.

Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction

Applications without a video will not be considered.

questions:

Please speak naturally. We are evaluating your communication skills, English proficiency,

confidence, sales ability, and problem-solving skills, not your video production skills.



How to Apply

Please submit:

● Your updated resume.

● Your 2–3 minute video introduction.

● A short description of your relevant sales experience.

Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: Instagram Video Editor / Content Manager
description:
# Experienced Short-Form Video Editor & Content Manager | $800–$1,500/Month



We're looking for an experienced, detail-oriented **Short-Form Video Editor & Content Manager** to join our team in a long-term capacity.



This is not an entry-level position, and we're not looking for someone who needs constant direction or multiple rounds of feedback to produce great content.



We want someone who takes pride in their work, has excellent attention to detail, and can independently deliver high-quality videos that match our established editing style.



**Our goal is simple: We provide the raw footage, reference videos, and detailed SOPs. You deliver polished, ready-to-publish content that meets our standards.**



We're a growing company, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, take ownership of their responsibilities, and earn more as the company succeeds.



## Responsibilities



**Video Editing**

- Produce approximately **60 original short-form videos per month** for Instagram.

- Create additional variations of videos as needed for Instagram Trial Reels.

- Match the editing style of reference videos we provide, including pacing, captions, cuts, music, sound effects, and visual elements.

- Follow our detailed SOPs to ensure consistency across all content.

- Review every video carefully before submitting it to catch errors in spelling, audio, timing, formatting, and visual quality.

- Deliver finished videos that require minimal revisions.



**Content Management**

- Schedule and publish content according to our posting calendar and SOPs.

- Ensure videos, captions, and other publishing details are correct.

- Keep content files, schedules, and completed work organized.

- Monitor publishing to make sure everything goes out correctly and on time.

- Take ownership of the entire editing and publishing process.



## What We're Looking For



**1. Strong attention to detail**



We expect you to catch the small things that other editors might overlook. Misspelled captions, awkward cuts, inconsistent audio levels, poor framing, and incorrect formatting should all be caught before submission.



**2. Independent problem-solving**



We don't want someone who needs to ask what to do every time a minor issue comes up.



We want someone who can review our SOPs, use good judgment, and find solutions independently. We encourage questions when clarification is genuinely necessary, but we value people who take initiative.



**3. Minimal revisions**



One of our biggest priorities is avoiding unnecessary back-and-forth.



We understand that occasional feedback is part of the process, but we expect you to carefully review your own work and consistently deliver videos that meet our standards on the first submission.



**4. Experience with short-form video editing**



You should already know how to produce polished, engaging Instagram content. We're happy to teach you our specific editing style, but we're not looking to teach someone how to edit videos from scratch.



**5. Reliability and accountability**



We need someone who meets deadlines, communicates clearly, stays organized, and takes ownership of their work.



**6. A long-term mindset**



We're not looking for someone who just wants another short-term freelance project.



We want someone who is excited about becoming part of a growing company, improving our systems, taking on greater responsibility, and increasing their earnings over time.



## What We Provide



We have established systems designed to make your job straightforward and repeatable.



You'll receive:

- Raw video footage

- Reference videos demonstrating the exact editing style we want

- Detailed video editing SOPs

- Content management and publishing SOPs

- Clear expectations and feedback during onboarding



You will not be responsible for creating our content strategy or coming up with new content ideas. Your primary responsibility is to execute our established process accurately, efficiently, and consistently.



## Compensation & Growth Opportunities



**Base salary: $800 USD per month**



**Total earning potential: Up to $1,500 USD per month**



In addition to your base salary, we offer performance-based bonuses tied to:

- Company performance and growth

- Content KPIs

- Quality, consistency, and reliability of execution



We believe in rewarding team members who contribute to our success.



As the company grows, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibilities, develop professionally, and increase their earnings.



We're looking to build a long-term working relationship with someone who sees this as more than just another editing gig.



## Hiring Process



**We do not require portfolios, resumes, or lengthy cover letters. Instead, every applicant must complete a short practical editing test.**



We care about your ability to do the job, not how impressive your application looks.



For this test, we have provided:

- Raw footage for you to edit

- A reference video showing the editing style we expect

- Editing instructions and SOPs



**Access the editing test here:**



[

Your task is to turn the raw footage into a polished, finished video that closely matches the reference example.



We want to see how well you can follow instructions, pay attention to details, and use your own judgment to deliver a high-quality finished product.



**Please treat this assignment as if you were submitting a final video to a client.** Review your work carefully before sending it. We're looking for someone whose first submission is already close to the final product, without needing multiple rounds of revisions.



We will review completed submissions and contact applicants whose work meets our standards.



## How to Apply

, include:

We're excited to find someone who can become a valuable, long-term part of our team.

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
1.
 Strategy & Revenue

• Build and run an annual and quarterly
 strategy tied to DTC revenue goals, product launches, and promotional calendars.

• Own
's contribution to total DTC revenue, revenue per recipient (RPR), and customer lifetime value.

• Balance promotional and content-led sends so we grow revenue without burning the list.

• Partner with brand and creative on messaging that speaks authentically to Black and multicultural women and their hair care routines (hair growth, edges, scalp health, moisture, protective styling, relaxer care).

2. List Health, Suppression Recovery & Re-Engagement

• Run a full audit of the Klaviyo account on arrival: total vs.
able vs. suppressed profiles, broken down by suppression reason (unsubscribed, spam complaint, hard bounce, invalid
, manual suppression).

• Identify which suppressed cohorts can be legitimately recovered (for example, manually suppressed or sunsetted profiles who never unsubscribed) and which must stay suppressed permanently (unsubscribes, spam complaints, hard bounces).

• Design and run re-permission and reactivation programs: re-opt-in campaigns, cross-channel recapture (SMS, paid social custom audiences, on-site and post-purchase capture), preference centers, and win-back flows.

• Reintroduce recovered and low-engagement profiles to sending through careful, staged warm-up so inbox placement is protected for the whole list.

• Build and maintain engagement tiers (e.g., 30/60/90/180/365-day engaged) and a sunset policy that keeps the active list healthy.

• Grow the engaged audience month over month, and report on it as a primary KPI, not just total list size.

3. Deliverability

• Own sender reputation: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, dedicated sending domain, and branded tracking links.

• Stay compliant with Gmail and Yahoo bulk-sender requirements (authentication, one-click unsubscribe, spam complaint rate under 0.3%, with an internal target well below 0.1%).

• Monitor Google Postmaster Tools, Klaviyo deliverability reporting, and inbox placement; diagnose and fix drops quickly.

• Manage list hygiene, validation, and bounce handling.

4. Segmentation & Personalization

• Build advanced segments using purchase behavior, RFM, product affinity, hair type and concern, browse and site activity, and Klaviyo predictive analytics (predicted CLV, churn risk, expected next order date).

• Personalize content blocks, product recommendations, and offers by segment.

• Use zero- and first-party data (quizzes, preference centers, surveys) to deepen profiles.

5. Flows & Automation

• Audit, rebuild, and optimize the core flow library: welcome series, browse/cart/checkout abandonment, post-purchase and education, replenishment (timed to product usage cycles), cross-sell, VIP, win-back, and sunset.

• Coordinate
 and SMS so customers get one consistent experience rather than duplicate messaging.

• Target flows driving a strong, growing share of
 revenue.

6. Testing & Analytics

• Run a disciplined testing roadmap: subject lines, send times, offers, creative, flow timing, and segmentation logic.

• Build weekly and monthly reporting on revenue, RPR, open and click rates (with Apple MPP caveats), conversion, list growth, engaged-profile growth, reactivation, and deliverability.

• Turn data into clear recommendations for leadership.

Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30: Audit and stabilize. Complete a full account, deliverability, and suppression audit. Deliver a written diagnosis of list health, flow performance, and revenue opportunity. Fix any authentication or compliance gaps.

Days 31–60: Rebuild the foundation. Launch engagement tiers and a sunset policy. Rebuild the highest-impact flows. Present and begin executing the suppressed-profile recovery plan, starting with the safest cohorts.

Days 61–90: Scale. Run staged re-engagement and warm-up of recovered profiles. Launch the testing roadmap and a monthly performance dashboard. Show measurable movement in engaged-profile count and
 revenue.

What You Bring (Must-Haves)

• 6+ years in
 or lifecycle marketing, with at least 4 years hands-on in Klaviyo as the day-to-day owner (not only overseeing an agency).

• Direct experience managing a Klaviyo account of 1M+ profiles, including real responsibility for its deliverability and revenue.

• A documented track record of suppression recovery and re-engagement: you can show before-and-after numbers for engaged profiles, inbox placement, and revenue.

• Deep knowledge of deliverability: authentication, warm-up, reputation management, Gmail/Yahoo sender requirements, and CAN-SPAM/consent compliance.

• Advanced segmentation skills, including RFM and Klaviyo predictive analytics.

• Strong analytical ability: comfortable building reports, reading cohort data, and connecting
 activity to revenue.

• DTC e-commerce experience on Shopify.

• An understanding of, and respect for, the textured and ethnic hair care customer. Experience in beauty, hair care, or multicultural consumer brands is strongly preferred.

How You Will Be Measured

•
 revenue and
 share of total DTC revenue

• Revenue per recipient (campaigns and flows)

• Growth in engaged profiles (e.g., 90-day engaged) month over month

• Number of suppressed/disengaged profiles compliantly recovered and retained as engaged

• Deliverability health: inbox placement, Postmaster reputation, spam complaint rate, bounce rate

• Flow revenue growth and conversion rates

How to Apply

Please send your resume plus a short proof-of-work packet. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

1.  A case study of a list you managed at 500K–1M+ profiles: starting state, what you did, and the results (anonymized is fine).

2.  Before-and-after metrics for a suppression recovery or re-engagement program: engaged profiles, deliverability, and revenue.

3.  Screenshots or exports from Klaviyo or Postmaster Tools that support your numbers (client names may be redacted).

4.  A one-paragraph answer: "You inherit a 1M-profile Klaviyo account where 35% of profiles are suppressed and the engaged rate is declining. What do you do in your first 30 days?"

title: Trust Accountant, US Property Management (Remote)
description:
Trust Accountant, US Property Management (Remote)

***PROPERTY MANAGEMENT ACCOUNTING EXPERIENCE REQUIRED*** - Do not apply if you don't have 2+ years Property Management Accounting experience with Appfolio



About Us

Streamline Property Management is one the largest and fastest-growing professional property management firms located in the Washington DC area. We manage over 1,500 residential properties, delivering a seamless experience for both owners and tenants. As a fast-growing, entrepreneurial company, we move quickly and value team members who take initiative.



About the Role:

We are seeking a meticulous Trust Accountant to own the financial integrity of our residential portfolio. This is a specialized Trust Accounting role.

The Accounting Manager will be responsible for the financial integrity and reporting of the residential portfolio that Streamline manages on behalf of its owners. This role focuses on ‘Trust Accounting’ - the management of funds belonging to others (owners and tenants) and ensuring compliance with state real estate regulations and company standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Owner Distributions: Execute monthly owner payment cycles. Verify clearing status, run financial diagnostics, calculate management fees, and execute ACH payouts. via AppFolio

- Bank Reconciliations: Perform monthly three-way reconciliations between the bank balance, the software book balance, and the individual property ledgers

- Closing the Month: Ensure all AppFolio diagnostics are cleared and books are "clean" before the new cycle begins

- Oversee security deposit refunds, move-out accounting, and daily ledger adjustments (move-ins, chargebacks, etc.)

- Year-End Reporting: Prepare and distribute 1099s to vendors and owners; provide year-end financial packages for tax purposes



Requirements:

- 4+ years in accounting with at least 2 years in Residential Property Management accounting.

- Expert in AppFolio or Buildium or another property management software - You should know the shortcuts, the reports, and how

- Strong understanding of Trust accounting principles

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA will be considered an asset

- Fluent English, great written and verbal communication

- Must be available to work US Eastern Time hours



Benefits & Perks

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, remote contractor position

- Paid time off vacation as well as holidays (~20 total days per year)

- Opportunities for growth in both pay and responsibilities

- Be part of a supportive and friendly small team

- Stability and consistency - we are a long-term employer

title: Systems Analyst, Accounting & AI
description:

Full time, Los Angeles business hours. Up to ₱225 per hour, paid for hours worked. Opportunities for quick advancement. If the hours or pay don't work for you, please don't apply. We are excited to work with you!



Only Applications sent through this link will be considered: 





About us



We are a property management company in Los Angeles. We run the business on our own software: leasing, maintenance, inspections, move-ins and move-outs, tenant and owner portals, staff hours, payroll and accounting. We build it with Claude, an AI that writes the code.



The role:

You run the day-to-day development of that software. You d
 what needs building or fixing, instruct Claude, test the result, and make sure staff can use it.

You don't need to code. You do need to know accounting and how business systems are set up, well enough to spot when a number is wrong and find out why.

One hour it's a wrong label on a screen. The next it's an owner statement that won't balance. You report to the head of technology.



What you'll do:

Write clear instructions for Claude to build features and fix problems.

Test every change in our test environment before it goes live.

Take bug reports from staff, find the cause, get it fixed, and confirm with them.

Answer staff questions about the system using the actual records.

Keep the system documentation current.

Know how money moves: rent, owner payouts, management fees, vendor bills, security deposits, payroll, bank accounts.

When the bank, Buildium and owner ledgers disagree, find the reason and get it corrected.

Make sure no payment leaves the system without a person approving it.

You troubleshoot to the root cause, not the symptom.



Nice to have:

Daily use of Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot at work.

US property management accounting: owner statements, security deposits, trust reconciliations.

Business systems analyst or ERP consultant background.

Payroll experience (Gusto or similar).



What the first 90 days will look like:

Days 1-30: learn the software and how to work with Claude, starting with small fixes.

By day 90: own bug reports and staff questions end to end, shipping fixes across the system.



Requirements: 

Degree in accounting, finance or accounting information systems.

Solid accounting knowledge: reconciliations, AP and AR. Trust accounting a plus.

Experience setting up or running a business system: accounting software, ERP, CRM, or property management software (Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi).

Excellent written English.

Can juggle many tasks, from quick fixes to complex accounting questions.

No coding needed. SQL, advanced spreadsheets or automation experience a plus.

No 2025 or 2026 graduates.



Benefits:

Paid training

Work from home

Promotion path

Performance-based raises

Company Christmas gift

title: URGENT: AU Tax Accountant
description:
ROLE SUMMARY



Senior-level Australian public-practice role responsible for tax compliance, tax planning, financial analysis, and business advisory for SMEs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Prepare and review financial statements and income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Prepare and review BAS and IAS, including GST and PAYG reconciliations.

- Review shareholder and related-party loan accounts and assess Division 7A, including complying loan arrangements, benchmark interest, minimum yearly repayments, distributable surplus, and deemed-dividend exposure.

- Prepare and review CGT calculations, including CGT events, capital proceeds, cost base, capital losses, discounts, concessions, and rollovers.

- Prepare and review FBT calculations and returns, including motor vehicles, entertainment, employee contributions, exemptions, reductions, and taxable values.

- Review trust taxable income, beneficiary entitlements, distribution resolutions, franking implications, and Division 7A considerations involving corporate beneficiaries.

- Prepare book-to-tax adjustments, tax reconciliations, franking-account reconciliations, and supporting tax workpapers.

- Perform quarterly tax planning using year-to-date results and projected full-year profitability.

- Calculate projected income-tax liabilities and assess PAYG instalments and upcoming tax cash requirements.

- Prepare budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow analysis for business advisory engagements.

- Analyse profitability, working capital, cash-flow constraints, financial trends, and business performance.

- Assist with business structuring, tax planning, technical taxation research, and written client advice.

- Handle technical client queries and ATO correspondence within delegated authority.

- Review accounting and taxation work prepared by other team members.

- Communicate directly with clients to request information, explain tax positions, discuss financial results, and provide practical commercial advice.

- Maintain high-quality workpapers, supporting documentation, client files, and compliance workflows.



REQUIREMENTS



- CPA qualification is a BIG PLUS.

- Minimum 5 years of Australian public-practice accounting and taxation experience.

- Strong Australian taxation knowledge across companies, trusts, partnerships, sole traders, and individuals.

- Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, FBT, GST, BAS, IAS, PAYG, trust distributions, and tax planning.

- Strong financial-statement preparation and tax-return preparation/review experience.

- Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect tax outcomes with the client’s cash flow, profitability, strategy, and business objectives.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.



TOOLS



Xero | Xero Tax | Xero Practice Manager (XPM)



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.

IMPORTANT: Include a Google Drive link to your resume and ensure the file is set to “Anyone with the link can view.”

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Good attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

- Commitment to confidentiality and professional conduct.



Work Schedule



The position begins at approximately 20 hours weekly. Most hours must overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for calls, training, and team coordination.



The weekly schedule will be agreed upon in advance. Flexibility is important, as live calling sessions may vary from week to week.



How to Apply



If you believe you are a good fit for this position, please submit the following:



Brief Introduction: Tell us about yourself and your relevant work experience.



CRM Experience: Briefly describe the tasks you've performed in GHL system.



Calling Experience: Describe your experience with outbound calls, lead generation, or appointment setting.



Availability: Indicate your availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Voice Recording (Required): Submit a 60–90-second voice recording in English covering the following:



Part 1: Imagine you are calling a potential client on behalf of LifeLink Consulting. Introduce yourself professionally and politely ask whether it is a convenient time to speak.



Part 2: Inform the client that you are calling to talk about a responsibility or task you particularly enjoyed in a previous job. Explain what you did and why you enjoyed it.



Please speak naturally and record in a quiet environment. You may submit a Google Drive, Vocaroo, or similar recording link. Ensure that your recording is accessible without requesting additional permission.



Important: Begin your application with the words "LifeLink Operations" to confirm that you have read the instructions carefully.

title: Social Media & Growth Content Strategist (Short-Term Rental & Real Estate Brand)
description:
Social Media & Growth Content Strategist (Short-Term Rental & Real Estate Brand)



Job Type: Part-Time / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work from Home)

Schedule: Flexible (Deadline-Based)



About Us



We are a growing short-term rental (STR) property management company managing a portfolio of curated vacation homes.



We are looking for a results-driven Social Media & Content Strategist—not just a graphic designer or post scheduler. Our social media needs to serve two clear business goals:



Guest Acquisition (B2C): Inspiring travelers to book direct stays at our vacation homes.

Owner Acquisition / High-ROI Growth (B2B): Attracting second-home owners and real estate investors to hire us to manage their properties.



If you understand how to create high-converting content that builds brand trust, generates leads, and delivers a measurable return on investment (ROI), keep reading.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who understands B2B lead generation and conversion strategy, not just vanity metrics like likes and views. You know how to position a brand as an authority to attract high-net-worth property owners while still appealing to vacationers. You have a sharp eye for modern, clean, boutique-hotel-inspired design, and you know how to turn existing static assets (property photos, guest clips, stock footage) into high-performing Reels and Carousels without needing weekly raw footage from our team. Above all, you take ownership of performance and can clearly articulate how your content drives revenue.



This role is NOT for someone who only makes aesthetic travel mood boards, uses generic Canva templates, or treats social media as a "set it and forget it" scheduling task.



The Challenge & Dual Strategy



Our team doesn't have time to film new videos every week. Using our existing property photos, guest videos, and stock or destination footage, you will build a dual-purpose content engine:



Pillar 1 — Attracting Property Owners (Primary ROI Driver): Creating educational, authority-building content such as revenue case studies, property transformation highlights, hosting insights, and passive income breakdowns that convince vacation home owners to partner with us.



Pillar 2 — Driving Guest Bookings: Showcasing our homes and local destinations in a way that converts scrollers into direct bookings.



Responsibilities



Manage and grow our Instagram and
 presence with a clear focus on lead generation and bookings.

Develop a monthly content strategy balancing Owner Acquisition (B2B) and Guest Bookings (B2C).

Design high-converting Carousels, Reels, Stories, and static graphics in Canva and CapCut.

Write persuasive, conversion-focused captions with clear Calls to Action (CTAs) for both property owners and travelers.

Design digital Guest Guidebooks and Owner Onboarding or Pitch Decks (marketing materials for prospective clients).

Track performance metrics including leads, inquiries, link clicks, and direct booking traffic, adjusting strategy based on what drives ROI.

Organize projects and content calendars in Notion or similar tools.



Our Brand Style



Our aesthetic is Modern, Minimal, Boutique-Hotel Inspired, Clean, Warm, and Trustworthy—luxury and competence without feeling flashy or salesy.



Requirements



Proven experience managing social media accounts with a focus on lead generation, real estate, hospitality, or service-based B2B growth.

Strong Canva and short-form video editing skills (CapCut, Reels).

Strong copywriting skills—you know how to write hooks and CTAs that make property owners inquire about management services.

Data-minded approach—you understand analytics beyond likes and know how to measure ROI.

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Canva AI, CapCut AI) to streamline workflows.

Experience in Short-Term Rentals, Real Estate, Hospitality, or Property Management is a major plus.



Portfolio Requirements



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application. Please include examples of Instagram Reels, educational or authority Carousel posts, clean modern Canva branding work, and examples of content created to generate leads, sell a service, or build brand authority (not just aesthetic lifestyle or travel posts).



Applications containing only generic flyers, menus, birthday graphics, quote posts, or basic VA work will not be considered.



To Apply



Please note that this position requires 15 Apply Points (AP) to submit an application. Anything below (or above) will not be reviewed.



Please include the following in your application message:



Your updated CV and Portfolio link.

Links to your 3 best Instagram Reels or Carousels (bonus points if they were designed to drive leads or sales).

The ROI Question (Required): We view this role as a direct investment in growing our property portfolio. How will you structure our content and measure success so that we see a clear return on investment—specifically in attracting new property management clients, not just vacation bookings?

Attention-to-Detail Check: Include the word "blueprint" in your application message so we know you read the full post.

Your expected monthly rate or salary.



We look forward to meeting someone who can help us build a high-converting brand and grow our portfolio.

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to own the full sales cycle, from initial prospect engagement and discovery through proposal, negotiation, follow-up, and closing.



This is NOT an appointment-setting or lead generation-only role.



You will be responsible for progressing qualified opportunities through the pipeline and converting them into signed clients.



ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES



* Contact and engage inbound and outbound leads

* Conduct discovery and qualification calls

* Understand prospects' businesses, pain points, requirements, urgency, and budgets

* Identify and present the appropriate solution based on client needs

* Build relationships with business owners and key decision-makers

* Manage opportunities from initial contact through to signed agreement

* Prepare and present quotations and commercial proposals

* Clearly communicate pricing, service structure, and business value

* Handle objections confidently

* Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters

* Consistently follow up until opportunities are closed or formally disqualified

* Establish a clear next step after every prospect interaction

* Re-engage stalled and inactive opportunities

* Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, pipeline stages, and follow-up dates

* Coordinate internally to confirm client requirements can be delivered

* Manage the handover of successfully closed clients

* Track pipeline activity, proposals, conversion rates, and closed revenue



REQUIREMENTS



* Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or consultative sales

* Demonstrated experience managing a FULL SALES CYCLE

* Strong track record of closing deals and generating revenue

* Strong discovery and qualification skills

* Confident presenting solutions and commercial proposals

* Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills

* Comfortable discussing pricing and commercial terms

* Confident speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong follow-up and pipeline-management discipline

* Experience using CRM and sales pipeline tools

* Able to manage multiple active opportunities simultaneously

HIGHLY PREFERRED

* GPS tracking

* Vehicle tracking

* Fleet management

* Telematics

* Automotive technology

* SaaS or technology solutions

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Initial Conversation → Discovery → Qualification → Solution → Proposal → Negotiation → Follow-Up → CLOSED DEAL



You should be comfortable owning the outcome rather than simply passing qualified leads to another salesperson.
