title: Senior eBay Beauty & Cosmetics Specialist (Product Research, Pricing & Listing Strategy)
description:
Senior eBay Beauty & Cosmetics Specialist (Product Research, Pricing & Listing Strategy)



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: 10–15 hours per week to start (Flexible schedule, potential to grow)

Pay Rate: $4.00 – $5.00 / hour (Commensurate with proven eBay expertise)

Employment Type: Part-Time / Ongoing



About the Role



I have a curated inventory of several hundred brand-new beauty products—including cosmetics, skincare, hair care, and fragrance—ready to list on eBay.



Because I am expanding into eBay for the first time, I am looking for a seasoned, self-directed eBay Specialist whose expertise I can rely on. You will not just be entering data; you will take ownership of researching products, guiding pricing strategy, ensuring eBay beauty category compliance, creating clean hero images, and building high-converting draft listings.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for an experienced eBay lister who knows the platform inside and out—specifically when it comes to beauty, skincare, and fragrance. You understand eBay SEO (Cassini), know how to spot brand restrictions (VeRO), understand batch code verification and expiration standards, and can confidently recommend pricing and listing strategies without needing hand-holding.



Responsibilities



Research full product details, variants, shades, sizes, UPCs, and batch codes/expiration dates from reliable manufacturer and retail sources.

Analyze active competition and eBay Sold/Completed listings to recommend data-backed, competitive pricing strategies.

Advise on eBay beauty category best practices, including condition guidelines (e.g., New with box vs. New without box), shipping setup, and brand compliance.

Create one clean, high-converting lead/hero image per product using Canva, Photoshop, or AI tools while keeping the product 100% accurate and compliant with eBay image policies.

Write SEO-optimized listing titles, clear original descriptions, select accurate categories, and fill out all Item Specifics thoroughly.

Save completed listings as drafts for review and launch.

Maintain a clean tracking spreadsheet logging inventory IDs, research links, pricing rationale, batch/condition notes, and eBay draft links.



Requirements



Proven, hands-on experience managing and listing products on eBay (experience with beauty, cosmetics, skincare, or fragrance is a major advantage).

Strong working knowledge of eBay pricing strategy, Terapeak/Product Research, and Sold listing analysis.

Familiarity with eBay beauty compliance, batch code lookup tools (such as CheckFresh), and brand restrictions.

Strong photo editing skills (Canva, Photoshop, or AI background tools) to produce clean, compliant main images.

Excellent written English and proactive communication—you are comfortable offering recommendations and flagging potential issues before they become problems.

Exceptional attention to detail regarding shades, sizes, formulas, and packaging conditions.



How to Apply



CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You MUST apply with 15 AP (Application Points) to be considered for this position. Applications submitted with less than 15 AP will NOT be reviewed.



To apply, please include the following in your proposal:



Portfolio and Proof of Experience: Links or screenshots of live/past eBay listings and product hero images you have personally created (especially in beauty, health, or retail).

Pricing Strategy Breakdown: Briefly explain how you use eBay Sold listings (and/or Terapeak) to determine a competitive listing price.

Beauty Listing Insight: Share one key rule, compliance tip, or best practice you follow when listing cosmetics, skincare, or fragrances on eBay.

Attention-to-Detail Check: Include the word "palette" in your application message so we know you read the full description.

title: Senior B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter
description:
You're the person other callers ask for openers. You are the A player in a team. You can get past a front desk, reach the owner, earn their trust in under a minute and leave them curious enough to book a call. If that's you, I want to talk.



About the role

Salon Ignite AI builds AI-powered lead generation and lead management systems for hair, beauty and wellness businesses across Australia: salons, day spas, skin and aesthetic clinics. My AI Assistants answer enquiries, book appointments 24/7 and turn old client databases back into bookings.



I'm looking for an experienced cold caller to open doors with salon, spa and clinic owners. Your job is to find the right businesses, reach the decision-maker, and book qualified owners into a 15-minute discovery call with me. Each call you book should come with real information about the business, so I walk in prepared.



This isn't a script-reading, 300-dials-a-day role. It's for someone who knows how to have a genuine two-minute business conversation, and who leaves the owner thinking "I want to hear more."



You'll work directly with me, the founder, with GoHighLevel (GHL), alongside the AI tools I build. You'll have real input into scripts, targeting and how the outbound process grows.



What you'll do

Find the right leads

• Build targeted lead lists in Apollo, Google Maps, Instagram, booking platforms (Fresha, Timely, Kitomba) and other sources

• Qualify businesses before you dial: 4+ staff, strong enquiry volume, signs of missed calls or slow replies

• Import, tag and keep lists clean in GHL so nobody gets called twice



Open the conversation

• Make outbound cold calls to salon, spa and clinic owners from the GHL dialler

• Get past front-desk staff and reception respectfully, and find the best time and route to the owner

• Build instant rapport and trust, speaking the language of the beauty industry

• Spark curiosity about how AI can win them more bookings, without overselling or pitching price



Qualify and book

• Uncover key details on the call: team size, booking software, enquiry channels, missed-call pain, decision-maker, timing

• Book qualified owners into a 15-minute discovery call in my GHL calendar

• Follow up no-shows and "call me later" leads by phone, SMS and
 until they're booked or closed out



Keep the CRM sharp

• Log every call with clear, useful notes that I can read in 30 seconds before a discovery call

• Update pipeline stages, tags, tasks and call outcomes in GHL the same day

• Report weekly on dials, conversations, owner connects, calls booked and show-up rate

• Share what you hear on the phones (objections, wins, patterns) to sharpen scripts and targeting



Top 3 skills

1.  Owner-level cold calling and gatekeeper navigation. Getting past reception to the owner, then earning trust and curiosity in the first 30 seconds. You handle "they're busy" and "just send an
" without breaking stride.

2.  Discovery-style qualifying. Asking sharp questions that get real business information (team size, systems, pain points, decision-maker) while the owner still feels it's a conversation, not an interrogation.

3.  Lead generation and CRM discipline. Building qualified lists in Apollo and other sources, then running your whole day inside GoHighLevel: dialling, notes, pipelines, tasks and calendar booking.



What you'll bring

Must have

• 3+ years of B2B outbound cold calling to small business owners, ideally in Australia, the UK or the US

• A proven appointment-setting track record you can show in numbers (calls booked per week, show-up rate)

• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience: calling from GHL, notes, pipelines, tags, tasks and calendars

• Experience building lead lists with Apollo (or similar tools like Lusha, Seamless or LinkedIn Sales Navigator)

• Fluent, near-native spoken and written English: clear, warm and confident on the phone, easily understood by Australian business owners, and able to write CRM notes, SMS and
s without errors

title: BUSINESS SETUP & OFFICE ESTABLISHMENT
description:
# HIRING: EXPERIENCED BUSINESS SETUP & OFFICE ESTABLISHMENT COORDINATOR – METRO MANILA



**Company:** Cleanexo – Australian Cleaning & Removalist Business  

**Location:** Metro Manila, Philippines  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Project Coordination  

**Working Arrangement:** Must be available for office inspections, government office visits and in-person meetings when required.



## ABOUT THE POSITION



We are an established Australian cleaning and removalist business looking to establish our own physical office in Metro Manila, Philippines.



We are looking for an experienced and highly organised professional who can assist us with the entire process of setting up our Manila office.



We need someone who understands the Philippine business environment and knows how to coordinate office leasing, company registration, government permits, legal requirements, accounting, office infrastructure and all other necessary arrangements.



We want someone who can take ownership of this project and help us establish the office from start to finish.



**This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We need someone with actual experience in business setup and office establishment in the Philippines.**



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Finding the Right Office

- Research suitable commercial office spaces across Metro Manila.

- Find offices suitable for approximately 10–30 employees.

- Compare rental prices, locations and facilities.

- Contact property agents and landlords.

- Arrange office inspections and meetings.

- Negotiate rental prices and lease conditions.

- Provide management with different office options and recommendations.

- Calculate rental deposits, advance payments and other associated costs.



### 2. Government Registrations & Legal Requirements

- Research all requirements for establishing our Philippine operations.

- Coordinate with the relevant government departments.

- Identify the appropriate business registration structure.

- Coordinate SEC or DTI registration, as applicable.

- Assist with BIR registration and tax requirements.

- Coordinate barangay clearance and Mayor's/Business Permit.

- Identify applicable DOLE and employment requirements.

- Coordinate SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG employer registrations.

- Identify foreign ownership and investment requirements.

- Coordinate with lawyers and accountants where required.

- Prepare a complete checklist of documents, fees and procedures.



### 3. Office Setup & Requirements

- Research office furniture and equipment suppliers.

- Obtain quotations for desks, chairs, computers and monitors.

- Arrange internet, networking and electricity.

- Organise CCTV and office security.

- Arrange office supplies and other necessary equipment.

- Compare suppliers and negotiate pricing.

- Coordinate contractors and installation.

- Prepare the office so it is ready for staff to commence work.



### 4. Accounting, Banking & Administration

- Identify suitable accountants and bookkeeping providers.

- Coordinate business bank account opening requirements.

- Research accounting software and payroll systems.

- Identify insurance and other business requirements.

- Coordinate legal documentation and agreements.

- Establish administrative procedures and recordkeeping systems.



### 5. Recruitment & Office Staffing

- Research recruitment requirements for the Manila office.

- Assist with finding and hiring office employees.

- Coordinate interviews and onboarding.

- Help establish HR and payroll procedures.

- Prepare employee documentation and records.



### 6. Budgeting, Research & Project Coordination

- Prepare a complete office establishment budget.

- Obtain quotations from different suppliers.

- Compare office rental options and operating expenses.

- Calculate estimated initial setup costs.

- Prepare a list of government fees and registration expenses.

- Create a step-by-step office establishment timeline.

- Provide regular updates to Australian management.

- Follow up on all outstanding tasks until completion.



## ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



1. Previous experience setting up an office or establishing a business in the Philippines.

2. Good knowledge of Philippine government registration and permit requirements.

3. Experience dealing with SEC, BIR, DTI and local government offices.

4. Experience finding and negotiating commercial office leases.

5. Strong understanding of office administration and business operations.

6. Experience coordinating lawyers, accountants and suppliers.

7. Strong research, budgeting and quotation comparison skills.

8. Excellent spoken and written English.

9. Strong negotiation and communication skills.

10. Must be based in or able to work across Metro Manila.

11. Must be comfortable attending in-person meetings, property inspections and government offices.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. Have you previously helped establish an office or register a business in the Philippines?

2. How many years of experience do you have in business setup and administration?

3. Which government registrations and permits have you personally handled?

4. Have you previously dealt with foreign-owned or international businesses?

5. Have you found and negotiated commercial office spaces?

6. Can you coordinate the entire office establishment process from start to finish?

7. Are you currently based in Metro Manila?

8. Can you attend government offices, property inspections and supplier meetings?

9. Please provide examples of previous office setup or business establishment projects you have completed.



## IMPORTANT NOTICE



We are looking for someone who can genuinely help us establish our Manila office.



We do not want someone who will simply provide information or send us links. We need someone who can research, contact relevant organisations, obtain quotations, arrange meetings, coordinate documentation, follow up with government departments and manage the necessary tasks.



You will work directly with our Australian management team and help us establish the office from the ground up.



**If you have previous experience in business establishment, office setup and Philippine government requirements, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Media Buyer (Lead Generation, Performance-Focused)
description:
About the business

I'm Markus. I run Restive Collective, a marketing agency in Singapore. We run high-ticket client acquisition for business owners: ads that book qualified sales calls for premium offers — coaching, consulting and professional services.

We manage five figures a month in ad spend across our clients' accounts, plus our own. Every funnel we run has the same job: turn ad spend into qualified booked calls that close.



We are looking for a results-driven Media Buyer to join our growing team



About the Role



We are looking for a results-driven Media Buyer to join our growing team.



Your primary responsibility will be to execute, manage, monitor, and optimize Meta 
 and Instagram) advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads and booked appointments for our business and clients.



You will work closely with our management and marketing team to implement established advertising strategies, monitor campaign performance, and identify opportunities for improvement.



We're looking for someone who is analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity and campaign performance.



This is primarily a hands-on campaign execution and optimization role, rather than a position responsible for independently developing the company's overall marketing strategy.



Key Responsibilities



1. Campaign Setup & Management



Set up, launch, and manage Meta advertising campaigns based on approved strategies, objectives, and budgets.



Manage multiple advertising campaigns and accounts.



Ensure campaigns are correctly configured, including targeting, placements, creatives, and tracking.



Monitor campaign spending and ensure budgets are used efficiently.



2. Campaign Monitoring & Optimization



Monitor campaign performance daily and identify opportunities for improvement.



Optimize audiences, creatives, placements, and campaign settings based on performance data.



Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives, copy, hooks, and targeting.



Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend adjustments.



Implement approved changes to improve campaign performance.



3. Performance Analysis & Recommendations



Track key performance indicators, including Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Click-Through Rate (CTR), conversion rates, and booked appointments.



Analyze campaign data and identify trends, issues, and opportunities.



Propose advertising strategies, testing ideas, and optimization recommendations based on campaign results for management's review and approval.



Provide clear explanations and supporting data for proposed improvements.



Collaborate with management to implement approved recommendations.



4. Tracking & Lead Generation



Ensure campaign tracking is functioning correctly, including Meta Pixel, Conversion API (CAPI), and UTM parameters.



Monitor lead generation performance and identify potential tracking issues.



Work with the team to monitor lead quality and booked appointments.



Flag potential issues with funnels, tracking, or lead conversion for further review.



5. AI Tools & Creative Support



Use AI tools to assist with ad copy variations, creative ideas, research, and performance analysis.



Prepare basic creative variations when needed using available tools and templates.



Coordinate with the marketing or creative team on advertising assets.



Suggest new creative angles and testing ideas based on campaign performance.



6. Reporting & Communication



Prepare regular campaign performance reports.



Provide updates on advertising spend, leads generated, campaign performance, and optimization activities.



Communicate campaign issues promptly and recommend possible solutions.



Maintain organized campaign records and documentation.



Qualifications & Requirements



Required:



At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience managing Meta advertising campaigns.



Experience running lead generation campaigns.



Good understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign optimization.



Familiarity with advertising metrics such as CPL, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.



Ability to interpret advertising data and recommend improvements.



Basic understanding of Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, and UTM parameters.



Comfortable using AI tools to support daily tasks.



Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills.



Good written and verbal English communication.



Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.



Nice to Have (Not Required):



Experience with coaching, consulting, education, or service-based businesses.



Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Intellia.



Experience generating booked appointments through paid advertising.



Familiarity with Canva or AI-powered creative tools.



Knowledge of funnels and landing page conversion optimization.



What We're Looking For



We value someone who:



Takes ownership of assigned campaigns and delivers work reliably.



Is proactive in identifying problems and recommending solutions.



Follows established processes while suggesting improvements when appropriate.



Pays attention to performance data and makes informed recommendations.



Communicates clearly and works well with a team.



Is eager to learn, improve, and grow professionally.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience within the advertised range.



Remote work arrangement.



Opportunity to work with a growing business.



Exposure to multiple advertising campaigns and industries.



Hands-on experience using AI tools in digital advertising.



Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth.



Collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: General Admin VA | Exp in Electrical Trades, ServiceM8
description:
Application Form:



Role Overview



Candidates with hands-on ServiceM8 and Xero experience, a trades or service business background, and a warm, clear phone manner will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian electrical business needs an all-round admin and reception VA who can answer the phones, book and schedule work in ServiceM8, invoice every job, chase what is owed and bring structure to a business that has run on memory for ten years. This is a generalist role, but billing and cash flow sit at the centre of it. Every unanswered call is a lost job, and every uninvoiced job is money already earned and not collected.



The challenge is twofold. First, staying current: every call answered or returned the same day, every completed job invoiced the same day, and every payment reconciled so reminders only go to people who owe money. Second, the backlog: working with the owner to rebuild and bill past work using printed job lists, wholesaler invoices, vehicle tracking records and job notes, and to follow up invoices that have sat unpaid for months or years.



Success in the first 30 days looks like outstanding invoices being chased, every new job invoiced on the day, the unbilled backlog being rebuilt, and a clear list of what has been billed, what is outstanding and what has been paid. Beyond that, the VA becomes the business’s systems builder, turning what is in the owner’s head into documented processes so she can hire a qualified electrician and step back.



What You’ll Own



Invoicing, Collections & Cash Flow (Priority)



Invoice every completed job on the same day, including emergency call-outs

Chase outstanding invoices politely and firmly, including old invoices from 2024 onwards, and including small amounts

Set up and manage automated follow-ups in ServiceM8, then pick up the phone when they go unanswered

Work with the owner to rebuild past unbilled jobs using her printed job list, wholesaler invoices, vehicle tracking time-on-site records and job notes

Keep a clear tracker of what has been billed, what is outstanding, what has been paid and how many times each invoice has been followed up



Phones & Customer Communication



Answer the work number with a warm, local feel, using ServiceM8 Phone so calls are logged against jobs

Take down caller details, job address and the nature of the work, and enter a job sheet in ServiceM8

Transfer urgent calls (emergencies, builders, anything needing the owner) through directly

Action and clear the voi
 backlog and return all missed calls the same day

Answer client billing questions on the owner’s behalf

Triage personal calls that come through on the work number and pass them on via WhatsApp



Scheduling & Job Management



Book jobs and site visits into ServiceM8 and the owner’s calendar

Triage the
 inbox and ServiceM8 inbox daily so no enquiry goes unseen

Add job notes, plant details and site information to job sheets

Run a daily sweep: close out finished jobs, flag overdue items and check nothing has been missed

Monitor vehicle tracking to check the team has turned up to jobs as scheduled

Support the new purchase order process, matching wholesaler PO numbers to job sheets



Quoting & Variations



Create a job sheet as a quote when a caller wants one, and schedule the owner to look at it

Write up quotes from site notes, materials and labour hours sent by text or voice note on WhatsApp

Send quotes for approval before they go to the client until the process is signed off

Follow up every quote that goes out

Write up added scope as a sub-quote to the original, and get written approval before extra work starts



Bookkeeping & Business Numbers



Reconcile bank payments daily so customers who have paid stop receiving reminders

Keep the books clean and up to date for the accountant, who advises and lodges

Track the apprentice’s hours and timesheets, and support payroll preparation

Help separate business and personal spending so the owner can see the real numbers

Prepare simple reporting so the owner knows where the business stands



Marketing & Business Development



Help rebuild the business
 page after a hack, with access granted through Meta Business Suite rather than shared passwords

Post to
 and Instagram using job photos sent through

Make outbound cold calls to drum up new business when capacity allows



Systems, SOPs & Reporting



Document every process you’re taught, using recorded training sessions, and present it back for sign-off

Build templates for common jobs from past invoices so they can be reused

Over time, document how staff should be trained and onboarded so there is one uniform way of doing things

Suggest better ways of using ServiceM8 and running the back office

Send a morning WhatsApp with the day’s priorities and an end-of-day
 covering what was done, what is stuck and what needs review

Chase the owner for the information and approvals you need; she has asked to be reminded



What We’re Looking For



Experience



Admin, reception or customer service experience in a trades or service business

Experience with job scheduling, quoting and invoicing in a small business

Experience setting up processes or SOPs where none exist

Accounts receivable and debt collection experience is a strong advantage



Communication Skills



Excellent spoken English with a warm, natural phone manner is essential: callers should feel they are talking to a local office, not a call centre

Confident taking calls from homeowners, builders, property managers and retirement villages

Clear, friendly written English for quotes, invoices,
s and payment reminders

Comfortable chasing overdue invoices politely and firmly

Comfortable making outbound cold calls for new business



Technical Proficiency



ServiceM8 experience strongly preferred (Tradify or Simpro experience is transferable)

Online phone and dialler systems, including call transfers

Xero or similar accounting software and basic bookkeeping

Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, spreadsheets and

 business pages, Meta Business Suite and Instagram



Organisational Skills



Captures every call, job and dollar in the system the moment it comes in

Keeps a backlog under control while handling a steady stream of new calls

Builds and maintains their own trackers for follow-ups and outstanding invoices

High attention to detail on quotes, materials and invoice amounts



Industry Understanding



Basic knowledge of common electrical jobs (fans, power points, switchboards, smoke alarms) to book and describe jobs accurately

Understands the difference between quoted work and do-and-charge (time and materials) work

Understands variations and why added scope must be approved in writing



Non-Negotiables



Very clear, natural spoken English on the phone

Commercially minded: treats an unbilled call-out or an unchased quote as real lost money

Persistent follow-up, including gently chasing the owner herself

Can work from half a brief, fill the gaps they can, and come back with specific questions for the rest

Calm under overwhelm: faces a large backlog steadily without being put off

Comfortable starting with almost no documented systems and building them from scratch

Learns quickly from short recorded training sessions and doesn’t need the same thing taught twice

Trustworthy and discreet with client, staff and financial information; banking access can start limited and expand as trust builds

Friendly and easygoing, fitting a busy, chatty family business



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start, with a likely upgrade to full-time

Good availability during the owner’s working day is needed, as the role covers the phones; ideally no second job that limits availability

Practical training: short recorded calls, photos of printed job lists sent over WhatsApp, and you documenting each process



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of billing and cash flow, with a visible, early impact as recovered cash comes back in

A chance to build the systems a business has run without for ten years, not just follow them

A warm, chatty, self-aware owner who wants someone she genuinely enjoys working with and who will keep her accountable

A likely path to full-time as the role grows

title: tiktok shop content editor
description:
Beauty & Skincare | High-Volume Content | Performance-Focused



About the Role



I'm a high-volume TikTok Shop affiliate creator specializing in beauty, skincare, and product-driven content.



I'm looking for a highly skilled, detail-oriented video editor who understands how to create engaging, fast-paced, conversion-focused short-form videos.



I film and post content daily and in high volume, so I need someone who works quickly, communicates effectively, meets deadlines, and maintains exceptional editing quality without sacrificing efficiency.



This is not simply about making videos look aesthetically pleasing. It's about understanding how editing influences viewer retention, buying decisions, and conversions.



Key Responsibilities



1. Video Editing & Pacing



Edit high volumes of short-form TikTok Shop videos daily.



Identify and remove unnecessary pauses, filler words, awkward transitions, and dead space.



Create clean, intentional cuts that maintain a natural conversational flow.



Understand when to use jump cuts, punch-ins, zooms, and transitions to maintain attention.



Prioritize strong opening hooks within the first 1–3 seconds.



Maintain engaging pacing without making videos feel overly edited or unnatural.



2. Keyframes & Visual Editing



Demonstrate strong knowledge of keyframing, motion tracking, and precise video cuts.



Use strategic zoom-ins, punch-ins, and reframing to emphasize important moments.



Add smooth, purposeful movement to otherwise stationary footage.



Properly position overlays, text, and product visuals without obstructing important details.



Maintain consistency in framing, resolution, and visual quality.



3. Sound Design & Audio Editing



Professionally clean and balance audio.



Remove unwanted background noise, clicks, and distracting sounds.



Strategically layer sound effects, audio overlays, and background music when appropriate.



Sync sound effects precisely with visual movements, cuts, and transitions.



Ensure voice audio remains clear, crisp, and the primary focus.



Understand when sound effects enhance retention and when they become distracting.



4. Text Overlays & Captions



Create attention-grabbing on-screen text that supports the video's hook.



Use strategic text placement, timing, and animation.



Highlight important product benefits, objections, and buying triggers.



Ensure captions are accurate, properly synchronized, and easy to read.



Maintain consistent branding, typography, and formatting.



Avoid excessive text or unnecessary visual clutter.



5. TikTok Shop & Conversion-Focused Editing



Understand TikTok Shop affiliate content and how editing impacts conversions.



Recognize the importance of hooks, watch time, retention, and purchase intent.



Understand how to structure edits around product demonstrations, benefits, objections, and calls to action.



Know when to emphasize before-and-after visuals, product texture, application, and results.



Understand the difference between content designed for entertainment and content designed to generate sales.



Stay informed about current TikTok Shop editing styles, trends, and successful beauty content.



Understand GMV Max and the importance of producing content suitable for paid amplification.



6. Beauty & Skincare Editing



Have experience editing beauty, skincare, makeup, or product demonstration videos.



Accurately represent skin texture, product color, and application results.



Avoid beauty filters, excessive smoothing, or misleading visual enhancements.



Understand how to highlight product textures, packaging, and demonstrations.



Maintain bright, clean, professional visuals with natural skin tones.



7. Speed, Organization & Daily Workflow



Handle a consistent, high-volume editing workload.



Deliver completed videos within agreed turnaround times, including same-day deadlines when required.



Organize raw footage, edited files, revisions, and final exports.



Work efficiently without needing constant supervision.



Communicate proactively about progress, deadlines, and potential delays.



Follow editing instructions precisely and implement revisions quickly.



Maintain consistent quality across every video, regardless of volume.



Required Qualifications



Proven experience editing short-form videos for TikTok, Reels, or YouTube Shorts.



Advanced proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.



Strong understanding of keyframes, audio layering, captions, pacing, and visual storytelling.



Exceptional attention to detail.



Ability to recognize and correct editing mistakes independently.



Experience working with high-volume creators or brands.



Ability to meet tight deadlines consistently.



Strong communication skills and willingness to receive feedback.



Reliable internet connection and an organized file-delivery process.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience editing TikTok Shop affiliate videos.



Experience with beauty and skincare creators.



Understanding of direct-response marketing and consumer buying psychology.



Familiarity with TikTok Shop content policies and advertising guidelines.



Experience analyzing viewer retention and improving edits based on performance.



Ability to identify opportunities to improve a video's hook or pacing without changing the creator's authentic voice.



What I'm Looking For



I need an editor who is:



Fast: Able to keep up with daily filming and a demanding posting schedule.



Extremely detail-oriented: Notices small mistakes before I do.



Creative: Understands how to make content engaging without unnecessary effects.



Conversion-minded: Recognizes that the goal is to generate sales, not just views.



Independent: Can follow an established editing style without needing constant direction.



Consistent: Delivers the same level of quality whether editing 3 videos or 20.



Reliable: Meets deadlines and communicates professionally.



How to Apply



Please submit:



A portfolio featuring your best short-form video edits.



At least 2–3 examples of beauty, skincare, or product-focused content, if available.



Your experience editing TikTok Shop affiliate videos.



Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60-second video.



Your daily editing capacity.



Your preferred editing software.



Your rates for ongoing, high-volume work.





I'm looking for a long-term editor who can grow with my content production and consistently deliver high-quality work at scale.

Therefore, I want to share the core values I myself believe in, and am looking for in the people I work with:



Excellence: We take pride in our craft and strive to create work we're genuinely proud of.



Integrity and Honesty: We are honest and authentic, even when and especially when it's difficult. Our words are honest to how we feel, and our actions reflect our promises. 



Growth: We're not just interested in getting the job done, but always striving to improve our skills and understanding of the world. Every project is an opportunity to grow and develop! Every setback is an opportunity to reflect and learn!



Passion and Engagement: 

We make creative decisions we are genuinely passionate about, and bring an enthusiastic attitude to life and work. Because life is short, it's best be have fun, even if it's work!





Next, after values, I'm looking for the following attributes. Someone with:

- Creative judgement and initiative

- Aesthetic sensibility

- Storytelling intuition

- Problem solving skills

- Attention to detail

- Ability to learn quickly



Lastly, I'd expect you to have the following skills:



- Video Editing: Proficient in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar editing software



- Pacing & Rhythm: Able to control the flow, timing, and energy of a video to maintain engagement, build tension, and create emotional impact.



- Storytelling: Able to construct a compelling narrative from raw footage, even without a detailed script.



- Sound Design: Able to use sound effects, ambience, and audio mixing to enhance storytelling and immersion.



- Color Grading: Able to create beautiful, consistent, cinematic looks across different shots.



Additional skills that would be helpful:



- Motion Graphics: Experience with After Effects, Fusion, or similar tools for titles, animations, and visual effects.



- Visual Effects: Experience with masking, compositing, tracking, and creative effects.





First Project



A ~3-minute cinematic travel vlog from my recent trip to China (Shanghai, Zhangjiajie, and Chongqing). Future collaborations may span a variety of formats, from talking head videos to documentaries.





How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your 2-3 best editing projects, showcasing the skills shared above.

2. Which editing software you use, and your editing experience.

3. A brief introduction of why and how you began your journey as a video editor, and your future goals and aspirations

4. What you are looking for in an ideal partnership

5. Optional: if you feel you want to further showcase your abilities beyond your portfolio, attach a quick edit of a few clips from the footages here, showcasing 

a) Your ability to color grade

b) Your ability to choose suitable music

c) Any creative judgements

Footage link: 
 



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small paid editing test.

title: Credit Repair Specialist
description:
About us



MO Solutions LLC is a US based credit repair company in Kenosha, WI. We help clients remove inaccurate items from their credit reports and build stronger credit. We are growing and need one person to own our client files and daily operations.



Job Summary



This is a full-time, long-term position for one person who can do these three jobs well: credit repair specialist, operations manager, and project manager. You will run client files from sign-up to results, keep our systems organized, and report progress to the owner every week. We want someone who takes ownership and does not wait to be told what to do next.



Responsibilities



Credit repair

• Review all three bureau reports and identify inaccurate, incomplete, or unverifiable items

• Build a dispute plan for each client and prepare dispute and validation letters

• Second each round on time and track bureau, creditor, and collector responses

• Update client files after every response and plan the next round



Client Communication

• Answer client
s, texts, and portal messages within one business day

• Send clear monthly progress updates in plain English

• Run onboarding and check in calls when needed





Operations

• Keep the CRM clean, current, and accurate for every client

• Follow up on failed payments and missing documents

• Write and update step by step processes for everything you do

• Manage the shared inbox, calendar, and client portal



Project management

• Track every client file, round, and deadline in one place

• Send weekly reports to main office, which include active clients, rounds sent, results, items stuck, and what you need

• Spot problems early and provide a solution



Experience

• 2+ years of hands-on credit repair experience with US clients

• Advance knowledge of the FCRA, FDCPA, and CROA

• Excellent written, speaking and understanding of the English language

• Excellent managing multiple client files at once without supervision

• Experience building or improving processes or leading a small team
